Sub MAKYAJ()

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

End Sub

Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 15 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	'S46T.SORT("RTESTARIH")

	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SPSTATUSU"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 6
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 62
	Grid(3,1) = 17
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 17
	Grid(7,1) = 18
	Grid(8,1) = 11

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(7,2) = "BÝRÝM FÝYAT"
	Grid(8,2) = "PARA BÝRÝMÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"
	Grid(7,4) = "T"
	Grid(8,4) = "T"

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	AlanUzunlugu = SagMargin - SolMargin
	p = 122
	k = 20
	u = 19
		'ÖZENPRES LOGO
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If trim(logo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+2, SolMargin+0.5, 15, 46, logo, 114)
	End If
		'LOGO SOLU DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight, k, 0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, pe1.GetRight+0.5,8,	AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, pe1.GetLeft ,8,AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"ozenpres@ozenpres.com")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK SAÐ DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight+0.5, k, 0)
		'ÖZENPRES ADRES BÖLÜMÜ
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+1, 	pe1.GetRight+0.5, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"TOSB-Taysad Org.San.Bölg.")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"1.CAD - 16.YOL - 6.PARSEL")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3,		AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Çayýrova / GEBZE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft,	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Tel: 0262 658 12 00 Fax: 0262 658 12 09")
		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ALT YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + k, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	CHAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
	Tel = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","TELEFONNO_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1) 
	ilgili = STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1)

		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ÝLK KUTU BÖLÜMÜ ALTI
	konum = pe1.GetBottom+2
	y = 2
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.Write(konum, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,	32,	"Tedarikçi Firma")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,102.5,": " & CHAdi)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,28, "Sipariþ No")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Trim(SiparisNo))
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,32,"Tel")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,33,": " & Tel)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,11,"Faks")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,34,": " & Faks)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+24, satiryuksekligi-y,28,"Sipariþ Tarihi")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1)))
	'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SÝPARÝÞ TARÝHÝ ALTI SATIR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 2, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	TEL_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)

		'SIRA NO, MALZEME BAÞLIKLARI
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop+0.5, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi-1 , Baslik)
		BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
		res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, pe1.getleft - 0.5, 113.5, 0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
		'SIRA NO ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM+0.5, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	'0 = SIRA NO
	'1 = MALZEME
	'2 = MÝKTAR
	'3 = BR.FÝYAT
	'4 = TUTAR
	'5 = BOS

	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satiryuksekligi= satiryuksekligi-3.4
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	satiryuksekligi = 5
		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = SatirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Degisken = "K" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "T" Then
				Degisken = "TAHMÝNÝ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			'res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "PARA BÝRÝMÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 7)
			Degisken_Ad2 = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",STOKKODU ,-1))
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1)) & " - (" & Degisken_Ad2 & ")"
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			'satirpozr = satirpozr + 0.5
			satiryuksekligi = satiryuksekligi + 6
		End If
		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)
	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	
	CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

		'KALEMLER ARASI YATAY SATIR ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 16
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)
		SATIR = SATIR + 7
	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEM SATIR SONU YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)
	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(S46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC + 2, SolMargin + 2, 5, 20, "NOTLAR :")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	Notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Notlar3 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 				NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "1- " & Notlar1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "4- " & Notlar4)
		'NOTLAR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'NOTLARALTI KONUMU
	NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1
	'rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	'Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")	
	'If rows > 4 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 4 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
	For i = 1 To rows
		If i > 4 Then Exit For
		Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
		'If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(PozAciklama + (2 + i) * sYuksekligi, Solmargin + 2, 5,AlanUzunlugu - 4,Mesaj)		
	Next
	'****************************************************************************************************************
		'AÇIKLAMA - KTA DAN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALIYOR. 
	'******	**********************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	For n = 1 To 10
		ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK46E", STOK46E.EVRAKNO, "OZELNOT" & n,0)
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.Write(ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC+SATIRATLA, pe1.GetLeft,4,187, "* " & ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) )
		SATIRATLA = SATIRATLA + 5.5
	Next
	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ ALTI KONUM
	SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 45, "ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	OPS_ADINA_ONAYLAYAN_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN  SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'SEVK ÞEKLÝ
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 36, "SEVK ÞEKLÝ")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub STOKRESIM_YAZ()

	Dim k,Wb,Sheet

'***********************************************
	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
'************************************************
	k.Visible = True
	satir = 2
	KolonYaz = 0
	Sayac = 1 
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	For i = 1 To LISTET.GetRecCount()
		'LÝSTE TABINDAKÝ GÖRÜNEN KOLON BAÞLIKLARINA GÖRE GRÝDLERÝN NOLARINI YAZ
		Baslik_StokKodu 	= Grid(4,2)
		Baslik_StokAd1		= Grid(5,2)
		Baslik_StokAd2		= Grid(6,2)
		Baslik_FasonKodu	= Grid(3,2)
		Baslik_FasonDurumu	= Grid(17,2)
		'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		If KolonYaz = 0 Then
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	1).Value = "S.No"
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	2).Value = "Resim"
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	3).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokKodu )
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	4).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokAd1)
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	5).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokAd2)	
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	6).Value = Trim(Baslik_FasonKodu)	
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	7).Value = Trim(Baslik_FasonDurumu	)	
		End If
		'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLON BASLIK ALAN ADINI GRID(4,0) OLARAK YAZDIRIP SATIR DEGERLERÝNÝ ALABÝLÝRÝZ.
		Deger_StokKodu	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(4,0),	i)
		Deger_StokKodu 	= Doc.LeftJustify(Deger_StokKodu, 24)
		Deger_StokAd1	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(5,0),	i)
		Deger_StokAd2	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(6,0),	i)
		Deger_FasonKodu 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(3,0), i)
		Deger_FasonDurumu 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(17,0), i)
		'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'RESÝM AL
		Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & Deger_StokKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
		'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
		If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			Set S0P = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")
			Doc.Load_Voucher Deger_StokKodu
			S0P.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
			ResimAl = Trim(S0P.FULLFILENAME1(1))
			Doc.Save_Voucher
			Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
		End If
		Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & Deger_StokKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
		ResimAl = Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
		Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & ResimAl
		If Resim1 <> "" THEN
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir+1, 2).rowheight = Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1,2).rowheight*2.5
			rtop = Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Top+1.5
			rleft= Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Left+1.5
			Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Select
			Set resim = Wb.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(resim1)) 
			resimadi=resim.Name
			wb.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
			resim.Left = rleft 
			resim.Top = rtop
  		
			k.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  			k.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  			k.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
		End If
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SATIRLARA DATALARI YAZDIRMA
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	1).Value = Sayac
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	3).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokKodu)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	4).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokAd1)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	5).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokAd2)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	6).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_FasonKodu)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	7).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_FasonDurumu)
		'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		KolonYaz = 1
		Satir = Satir + 1
		Sayac=Sayac+1
	Next
	SONSATIR = SATIR
	SONKOLON = 7

		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(SONSATIR, SONKOLON)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For u = 3 to SONKOLON
		Sheet.Columns(u).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(u).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Columns(1).Select		
	k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
	Sheet.Columns(1).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(1).Rows(2).RowHeight = 25
	Wb.Sheets(1).Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(1, SONKOLON)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Value = "ÖZENPRES KODLARI"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 14
	k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 15   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
	k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
	k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
'	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, 1), Sheet.Cells(2, SONKOLON)).Select
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 14
	k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 6   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
	k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
	k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
'	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	Sheet.Cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2014 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : STOK-RES
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : RESÝMLÝ LÝSTE
Kod : 
Public Ust, Sol, EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintForm()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 17
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 7
	SolMargin = 7
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 7
	BoydanAralik = 3
	EtiketBoyu = Doc.Div(AltMargin - Ustmargin, BoydanEtiketSayisi) - BoydanAralik 
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = EtiketBoyu + BoydanAralik
	EtiketEni = 190
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = EtiketEni
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	sagMargin = 196

	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
		if trim(LISTET.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor((EtiketNo-1) / EndenEtiketSayisi) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				sol = SolMargin
				if yEtiketSayisi = 0 and (EtiketNo Mod BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketlerArasi
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin - 1, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)

	StokKodu = LISTET.KOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	StokAdi2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")

	UrunAgaciFoyNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", StokKodu & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
	resim = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu+"000001", "EVRAKNO+TRNUM"))
	Musteri = GetCHKodu(StokKodu)
	MusteriAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Musteri, "")
	MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu, Musteri)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	res=pe1.setrotation (270)
	res = pe1.Picture(UST+5,5,10,20,Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & "opsLOGO.jpg", 16)
	res=pe1.setrotation (0)

	En1 = 40
	satirAra = 4.5
	
	YaziSol = pe1.GetRight + 1
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 15)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(Ust, YaziSol, 8, 40,"STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 8, 90,": " & "[ " & trim(StokKodu) & " ]")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop+3 + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"STOK ADI")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"STOK ADI 2")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"ÜRÜN AÐAÇ FÖY NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(UrunAgaciFoyNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"MÜÞTERÝ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(Musteri) & " - " & MusteriAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"MÜÞTERÝ STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & MusteriStokKodu)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust + EtiketBoyu -4, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust + EtiketBoyu +1, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

res = pe1.NoPen()
'res=pe1.setrotation (90)
res = pe1.Picture(Ust+5, 140, 10, 20,trim(Resim), 16)
'res=pe1.setrotation (0)

End Sub

Function GetCHKodu(StokKodu)
	rows =  Doc.SelectEQ("STOK0GT", "STOKCODE", StokKodu)
	if rows = 0 then
		GetCHKodu = "" 
		exit Function
	end if
	Set T_STOK0GT = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_STOK0GT_SELECT")

	GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)
	exit function

	if T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount = 1 then
		GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)
	elseif T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount > 1 then
		For i = 1 to T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount()
			Firma = Firma & i & ". " & trim(T_STOK0GT.KOD(i)) & " - " & trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",T_STOK0GT.KOD(i),"")) & vbcrlf 
		Next 
		k = inputbox(satirNo & ". satýr, Hangi firma için etiket basýlacak?" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & Firma,"dinamo","1")
		k = 1
		if Doc.cDbl(k) > 0 and Doc.cDbl(k) <= T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount then
			GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(Doc.cDbl(k))
		else
			GetCHKodu = ""
		end if
	end if
End Function

Sub PrintForm()	
	
	Dim pe1
	
	sayfaEni = 215
	sayfaBoyu = 150
	UstMargin = 24
	SolMargin = 10
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	satirBaslangic = 85
	satirsonu = satirbaslangic +10+ satiryuksekligi * 7
	toplamtutar=0

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

'----------------------------------------------------------------
	'STOK63T = FASON ÇIKIÞ ÝRSALÝYESÝ

	'SafePack ile boþ alanlarý kaldýrýr
	'Set S63T ile hayali bir tablo oluþturur
	'S63T Group ile Koda göre icmal alýr.

	STOK63T.SafePack()
	Set S63T = Doc.Select2("XXXSTOK63T", "STOK63T", "", "", -1)
	S63T.GroupBy2("KOD")

	'Sub STOK63T_Print(pe1)
	'	res = pe1.write(80+x, 5, 6,100,StokKodu)
	'	x=x+6
	'	Doc.DeleteTableObject "XXXSTOK63T"
	'End Sub

	satirSayisi = S63T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

'------------------------------------------------------------------------

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
	
		'StokKodu = S63T.KOD(i)
		'Miktar=S63T.SF_MIKTAR(i)

		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)

	Next

'------------------------------------------------------------------------

	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

'SAYFABASI

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
			
	chkod=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chad2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	VergiDairesi = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	VergiNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	evrakno = STOK60E.EVRAKNO(1)

i=4

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin + (satiryuksekligi*2)-4, 33, satiryuksekligi, 70, chad)	
	res=pe1.write(pe1.gettop() + satiryuksekligi+i, 20, satiryuksekligi, 70, chadres1)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.gettop() + satiryuksekligi+i, 20, satiryuksekligi, 70, chadres2)
	res=pe1.write(pe1.gettop() + satiryuksekligi+i, 20, satiryuksekligi, 70, chadres3)

	res=pe1.write(pe1.gettop() + satiryuksekligi+10, 20, satiryuksekligi, 70, trim(VergiDairesi))
	res=pe1.write(pe1.gettop() , 69, satiryuksekligi+8, 80,trim(VergiNo))

	res = pe1.write(53.5,175, satiryuksekligi, 18, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(67.5,175, satiryuksekligi, 18,sevktarih)

End Sub

'FORMSATIR
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)

	Dim satirpozr
		sol = solmargin

		If trim(STOK63T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic

		Else

			If satirNo = 1 Then
					'KALEMLERÝN OLDUÐU ÝLK SATIRIN ÜSTTEN AYARI
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic-3.0
			Else
					'KALEMLER ARASI MESAFE
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi+1.7

			End If
		End If		
		
			Sutun_miktar=15
			Sutun_adet=5
			Sutun_kod=40
			Sutun_ad=100				

		



			'DEGISKENADI ILE SF_MIKTAR GIBI TABLODAKÝ ALAN ADLARINI OKUTUYOR

			Degisken_miktar = trim(cstr(S63T.GetFieldValue("SF_MIKTAR",SatirNo)))
			Degisken_adet = trim(cstr(S63T.GetFieldValue("SF_SF_UNIT",SatirNo)))
			Degisken_kod = trim(cstr(S63T.GetFieldValue("KOD",SatirNo)))
			Degisken_ad = trim(cstr(S63T.GetFieldValue("KOD_STOK00_AD",SatirNo)))

			Degisken_FasonNo=doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_7",Degisken_kod,-1)

			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				
			'MIKTARI SAGA YASLA
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(0,6)
			Degisken_miktar=doc.numformat(Degisken_miktar, 18, Ondalik)	
				
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 6, 6, 30,Degisken_miktar)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 36.5, 6,  5,Degisken_adet)
			res = pe1.selectfont("arial",8)
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 43, 6, 40,Degisken_kod)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 82, 6,20,"(" & trim(Degisken_FasonNo) & ") - ")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, 102, 6,100, Degisken_ad)
			

res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)


End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	Call KOLON_BASLIK_YAZ() '////////// STOK KARTI RESÝM TABINDAN EXCELE LÝSTE

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub KOLON_BASLIK_YAZ()

	Dim ExcelApp, Wb1
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	satir = 5
	
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'kolonun alan adý
			AlanAdi1 = Grid(j,0)
				'kolonun geniþliði (pixel olarak)(0 ise gizlenmiþ demek) (1 mm = 3.2 pixel)
			AlanAdi2 = Grid(j,1)
				'kolonun alan baþlýðý
			AlanAdi3 = Grid(j,2)
				'kolonun databasedeki alan boþluðu (boþ)
			AlanAdi4 = Grid(j,3)
				'kolonun alan tipi (*); N:NUMERÝK, C:TEXT, D:TARÝH
			AlanAdi5 = Grid(j,4)
				'kolonun uzunluðu
			AlanAdi6 = Grid(j,5)
				'kolonun, nümerik ise noktadan sonraki hane sayýsý.
			AlanAdi7 = Grid(j,6)
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Deger = LISTET.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi1, i)
			If Grid(j,4) = "C" Then
				Deger = "'" & Deger
				Deger = Trim(Deger)
			End if
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,			j + 2).Value = AlanAdi1
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi2
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 2,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi3
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 3,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi4
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 4,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi5
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 5,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi6
			Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 6,	j + 2).Value = AlanAdi7
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Next

	Wb1.Sheets(1).Cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim ExcelApp, Wb1
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	satir = 5
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		satir = satir + 1
		if trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
			satir = satir + 1
			MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

			'RESÝM EKLE	

			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
			if S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				
				resim1 = trim(Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1)
				
				if resim1="" then
					
					resim1=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\RESIMCEK.jpg"
				end if

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
				'Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).columnwidth = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).columnwidth

				rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
								
				rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
				
				Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 

				resimadi=resim.name
				
    			wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
    
				resim.Left = rleft 
				resim.Top = rtop
    		
				ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
    			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
    			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45

				'resimadi=wb1.activesheet.shape.name
				'MSGBOX resim1

				'Resim.width = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).columnwidth+2.5
				'resim.height=25
				'resim.height = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight-1.5

			End if
			
'EXCEL DEKÝ KULLANABÝLECEÐÝMÝZ BAZI KODLAR
   ' With Selection
   '     .HorizontalAlignment = xlGeneral
   '     .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
   '     .WrapText = False
   '     .Orientation = 0
   '     .AddIndent = False
   '     .IndentLevel = 0
   '     .ShrinkToFit = False
   '     .ReadingOrder = xlContext
   '     .MergeCells = False
   ' End With

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
		End if

		For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
			if Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Deger = MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

				if Grid(j,4) = "C" Then

					Deger = "'" & Deger
					Deger = Trim(deger)

				End if

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,j + 2).Value = Deger
		
			End if
		Next

	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5

	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
		baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+2).Value = trim(baslik)
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(i + 2).autofit
	Next

	'WB1.ActiveSheet.cells.select
	'	With ExcelApp.Selection
        '.HorizontalAlignment = xlGeneral
   '     .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        '.WrapText = False
        '.Orientation = 0
        '.AddIndent = False
        '.IndentLevel = 0
        '.ShrinkToFit = False
        '.ReadingOrder = xlContext
        '.MergeCells = False
    'End With

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "STATUS"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 61
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 28

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "S.NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	

	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If

	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If

	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU-7 Then
		
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = satirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN" Then
			If Degisken = "1" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "2" Then
				Degisken = "ÖNGÖRÜ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End If

		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, 5, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2014 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : OPSKATALOG
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Resimli Ürün Kataloðu - Liste sayfasýndaki ürünler için
Kod : 
Public Ust, Sol, EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintForm()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 17
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 7
	SolMargin = 7
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 7
	BoydanAralik = 3
	EtiketBoyu = Doc.Div(AltMargin - Ustmargin, BoydanEtiketSayisi) - BoydanAralik 
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = EtiketBoyu + BoydanAralik
	EtiketEni = 190
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = EtiketEni
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	sagMargin = 196

	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
		if trim(LISTET.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor((EtiketNo-1) / EndenEtiketSayisi) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				sol = SolMargin
				if yEtiketSayisi = 0 and (EtiketNo Mod BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketlerArasi
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin - 1, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)

	StokKodu = LISTET.KOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	StokAdi2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")

	UrunAgaciFoyNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", StokKodu & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
	resim = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu+"000001", "EVRAKNO+TRNUM"))
	Musteri = GetCHKodu(StokKodu)
	MusteriAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Musteri, "")
	MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu, Musteri)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	res=pe1.setrotation (270)
	res = pe1.Picture(UST+5,5,10,20,Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & "opsLOGO.jpg", 16)
	res=pe1.setrotation (0)

	En1 = 40
	satirAra = 4.5
	
	YaziSol = pe1.GetRight + 1
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 15)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(Ust, YaziSol, 8, 40,"STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 8, 90,": " & "[ " & trim(StokKodu) & " ]" & "  FORMLARI")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop+3 + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"STOK ADI")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"STOK ADI 2")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"ÜRÜN AÐAÇ FÖY NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(UrunAgaciFoyNo))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"MÜÞTERÝ")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(Musteri) & " - " & MusteriAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, YaziSol, 5, En1,"MÜÞTERÝ STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & MusteriStokKodu)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust + EtiketBoyu -4, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust + EtiketBoyu +1, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

res = pe1.NoPen()
'res=pe1.setrotation (90)
res = pe1.Picture(Ust+5, 140, 10, 20,trim(Resim), 16)
'res=pe1.setrotation (0)

End Sub

Function GetCHKodu(StokKodu)
	rows =  Doc.SelectEQ("STOK0GT", "STOKCODE", StokKodu)
	if rows = 0 then
		GetCHKodu = "" 
		exit Function
	end if
	Set T_STOK0GT = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_STOK0GT_SELECT")

	GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)
	exit function

	if T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount = 1 then
		GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)
	elseif T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount > 1 then
		For i = 1 to T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount()
			Firma = Firma & i & ". " & trim(T_STOK0GT.KOD(i)) & " - " & trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",T_STOK0GT.KOD(i),"")) & vbcrlf 
		Next 
		k = inputbox(satirNo & ". satýr, Hangi firma için etiket basýlacak?" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & Firma,"dinamo","1")
		k = 1
		if Doc.cDbl(k) > 0 and Doc.cDbl(k) <= T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount then
			GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(Doc.cDbl(k))
		else
			GetCHKodu = ""
		end if
	end if
End Function

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2014 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : KLASOREYAZ
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Resimli Ürün Kataloðu - Liste tABI - ÝÞ EMÝRLERÝ
Kod : 
Public Ust, Sol, EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintForm()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 17
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 7
	SolMargin = 7
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 7
	BoydanAralik = 3
	EtiketBoyu = Doc.Div(AltMargin - Ustmargin, BoydanEtiketSayisi) - BoydanAralik 
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = EtiketBoyu + BoydanAralik
	EtiketEni = 190
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = EtiketEni
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	sagMargin = 196

	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
		if trim(LISTET.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor((EtiketNo-1) / EndenEtiketSayisi) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				sol = SolMargin
				if yEtiketSayisi = 0 and (EtiketNo Mod BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketlerArasi
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin - 1, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)
End Sub

Kod : 
Public 	PaketBilgisi,yaz,StokKodu,YeniCHKodu,satiryaz,TOPLAMMIKTAR,EVRAK_NUMARASI
Public ESKIEVRAKTYPE,ESKIEVRAKNO, BEKLEYENOPESKI, BEKLEYENOPKODUESKI,ETIKETTARIHI,ESKIBELGETARIHI,kx
Public GerceklesmeTarihi,Not1,ORJMIKTAR,ETIKET,etiketsec,IsNo,ISEMRI_STOKKODU,MUSTERIADI,MUSTERIKODU

'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	CALL PrintLabel()

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintLabel()

	ETKETSEC=""
	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)
	'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI = "TRM" Then 
		ETIKETSEC=3
	ElseIf KULLANICI	=	"TRM1" Then 
		ETIKETSEC=1
	Else
		ETIKETSEC	=	InputBox ("1- A5 SAYFADA 2 ETÝKET,                                     2- TABLOLU,                                                           3- BARKOD YAZICIYA", "BARKOD ETÝKET SEÇÝMÝ-SAYI GÝRÝN!","2")
	End If	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	If ETIKETSEC = "" Then Exit Sub
	If Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="2" Then
		SATIRYAZ=2
	ElseIf Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="1" Then
		SATIRYAZ=1
	ElseIf Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="3" Then
		SATIRYAZ=3
	Else
		SATIRYAZ=1
	End If
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	ETIKET="ETK-OPS2"
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Set DOC1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
	Set D7LB = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")
	If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK20" Then
		Call STOK20_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK68" Then
		Call STOK68_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		Call STOK60_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK25" Or Doc.GetDocType = "STOKFR2" Or Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK25" Then
		Call STOK25_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29" or Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29I" Then
		Call STOK29_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK36" Then
		Call STOK36_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK19" Then
		Call STOK19_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "SAYM11" Then
		Call SAYM11_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK21" Then
		Call STOK21_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK26" Then 
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK26T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK26" Then 
		'Call STOK25_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK63" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK63T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK61" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK61T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK24" Then
		Call STOK24_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "MMPS10" Then
		Call MMPS10_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType= "TRACK01" Then
		Call TRACK01_Print()
	End if
	Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "D7KIDSLB", ""

End Sub

Sub MMPS10_Print()

	If MMPS10E.STATUS <> "R" Then
		k = Doc.d7MsgBox("R Statüsünde olmayan MPS 'lerden etiket alamazsýnýz", "Hata", MB_OK+MB_ICONWARNING)
		Exit Sub
	End if
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXXSTOK20MPS=STOK20T", "TMPCOPY"
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Set S20T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXXSTOK20MPS")
		'OPERASYONA BARKOD ETÝKET TÜM SATIRLAR ÝÇÝN MÝ, TEK SATIR ÝÇÝN MÝ BASILSIN?
	QSTR = "R_KAYNAKTYPE='I'"
	If UCase(Right(Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),2),1))="S" Then
			'TEK SATIR
		QSTR = QSTR & "&SRNUM='" & MMPS10T.SRNUM & "'"
	End If
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Set M10TM = Doc.GetTableObject("MMPS10TM")
	Set M10T = Doc.Select2("ddrrg5","MMPS10T", QStr, "", -1)
	Set M10E = Doc.GetTableObject("MMPS10E")
	EVRAK_NUMARASI=MMPS10E.EVRAKNO
	'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For kkk=1 To M10TM.GetRecCount()
		ISEMRI_MIKTARI = MMPS10TM.SF_PAKETICERIGI(kkk)
	'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = 1 To M10T.GetRowCount()
			'----------------------------------------------------------------------
			ISNO=M10T.JOBNO(j)
			ISEMRI_STOKKODU=Trim(M10E.MAMULSTOKKODU)
			Call PRINTLABEL_OP(ISNO)
			'----------------------------------------------------------------------	
				'ÜSTTEKÝ Call ÝLE AÞAÐIDAKÝ BEKLEYEN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALINDI.
				'BEKLEYENOP_ISEMRINO	
				'BEKLEYENOP_KODU
				'BEKLEYENOP_NO
			'----------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set M10T = Doc.Select2("ddrrg43", "MMPS10T", QSTR, "", -1)
			BITENOP_KODU = M10T.R_OPERASYON(j)
			BITENOP_NO=M10T.R_SIRANO(j)
			'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
			If BEKLEYENOP_NO="" Then BEKLEYENOP_NO=BITENOP_NO+10
			'----------------------------------------------------------------------------
			QQQ = "R_KAYNAKTYPE='I'"
			Set M10TX = Doc.Select2("ddrrg43", "MMPS10T", QQQ, "", -1)
			ELDEEDILENURUN_STOKKODU=M10TX.R_YMAMULKODU(j)
			'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'AMBALAJ BÝLGÝSÝ
			PAKETBILGISI = GETKASAKODU(ELDEEDILENURUN_STOKKODU,CHKODU,SEVKADRESKODU)
			 	'AMBALAJ ÝÇÝ MÝKTAR
			DEFKUTUICIMIKTAR = GETSTDKOLIADET(ELDEEDILENURUN_STOKKODU,CHKODU,SEVKADRESKODU)
			'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			MAMULPAKETSAYISI = M10T.R_YMK_MPAKET(J)
			YARIMAMULPAKETSAYISI = M10T.R_YMK_YMPAKET(J)
			YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI = M10T.R_YMK_YMPAKETICERIGI(J)
			YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI = Doc.Round(YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI , 0)
				'YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI = Trim(Doc.NumFormat(YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI ,20, 0))
			TOPLAMYARIMAMULMIKTARI=M10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(J)
			TOPLAMYARIMAMULMIKTARI= Doc.Round(TOPLAMYARIMAMULMIKTARI, 0)
			'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
				'KTA GÝRÝÞÝ VARMI KONTROLÜ
			'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'KTA DA KUTUÝÇÝMÝKTAR GÝRÝLMÝÞ ÝSE MÝKTAR KTA DAKÝ MÝKTAR
			KUTUICIMIKTAR = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "KOLI_MIK",0)
			KUTUICIMIKTAR = Doc.Round(KUTUICIMIKTAR,0)
			If KUTUICIMIKTAR > 0 Then KTA_KUTUICIMIKTAR=1 
			'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'KTA DA ETÝKETADEDÝ GÝRÝLMÝÞ ÝSE ETÝKET ADEDÝ KTA DAKÝ MÝKTAR
			ETIKETADEDI = Doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E", MMPS10E.EVRAKNO, "ETIK_ADT",0)	
			ETIKETADEDI = doc.Round(ETIKETADEDI,0)
			If ETIKETADEDI > 0 Then KTA_ETIKETADET=1
			'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'EÐER KTA'DA KUTUÝÇÝMÝKTAR ve ETÝKET MÝKTARI GÝRÝLMEMÝÞ ÝSE  
			If KUTUICIMIKTAR = 0 And ETIKETADEDI = 0 Then KUTUICIMIKTAR = DEFKUTUICIMIKTAR 
				'EÐER KTA'DA SADECE ETÝKET MÝKTARI GÝRÝLMÝÞ ÝSE KUTUÝÇÝMÝKTAR AMBALAJ MIKTARI VARSA AMB.MÝKTARI YOKSA ÝÞEMRÝ Y.M.MÝKTARI  
			If KUTUICIMIKTAR = 0 And ETIKETADEDI <> 0 Then 
				If DEFKUTUICIMIKTAR=0 Then 
					KUTUICIMIKTAR=YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI
				Else	
					KUTUICIMIKTAR = DEFKUTUICIMIKTAR
				End If
			End If
 				'EÐER KTA'DA SADECE ETÝKET MÝKTARI GÝRÝLMÝÞ ve AMBALAJ MÝKTARI YOKSA KUTUÝÇÝMÝKTARI ÝÞEMRÝ MÝKTARIDIR  
			If KUTUICIMIKTAR = 0 Then KUTUICIMIKTAR = YARIMAMULPAKETICERIGI
			'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'EÐER ETÝKET ADEDÝ GÝRÝLMEMÝÞ ÝSE ETÝKET ADETÝ
			If ETIKETADEDI = 0 Then ETIKETADEDI = Doc.Ceil(Doc.Div(TOPLAMYARIMAMULMIKTARI, KUTUICIMIKTAR))
			'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS_2014 / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : OPSKATA_K
Hangi Tablo için : STOK00
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Resimli Ürün Kataloðu - Liste sayfasýndaki ürünler için_KÜÇÜK(m.özan)
Kod : 
Public Ust,BASLIK,Sol, EtiketBoyu,EtiketEni,i,pe1,SatirNo, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo,uzunluk,yazisol

Sub PrintForm()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 17
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 7
	SolMargin = 7
	BoydanEtiketSayisi = 20
	BoydanAralik = 3
	EtiketBoyu = Doc.Div(AltMargin - Ustmargin, BoydanEtiketSayisi) - BoydanAralik 
	BoydanEtiketlerArasi = EtiketBoyu + BoydanAralik
	EtiketEni = 190
	EndenEtiketlerArasi = EtiketEni
	EndenEtiketSayisi = 1
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket",sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	sagMargin = 196
	yazisol=5
	BASLIK=InputBox("Baslýk?", "Baslýk Yaz"," LÝSTESÝ")
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 to LISTET.GetRecCount()
		if trim(LISTET.KOD(i)) <> "" then
			AyniEtikettenKacTane = 1
			for j = 1 to AyniEtikettenKacTane
				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
				yEtiketSayisi = Doc.Floor((EtiketNo-1) / EndenEtiketSayisi) mod BoydanEtiketSayisi
				xEtiketSayisi = (EtiketNo - 1) mod EndenEtiketSayisi
				sol = SolMargin
				if yEtiketSayisi = 0 and (EtiketNo Mod BoydanEtiketSayisi = 1) and EtiketNo > 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
					Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
					Ust = Ustmargin					
				else
					Ust = Ustmargin + yEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketlerArasi
				end if
				Call Etiket(pe1,i)
			Next
		end if
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.2)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin - 1, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.NoPen
	res = pe1.Picture(5,5,10,20, Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & "opsLOGO.jpg", 16)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin-9, 30, 8, 160,BASLIK)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin, 15, 8, 50,"ÖPS STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin, 90, 5, 40,"ÖPS STOK ADI1 ve AD2")
	res = pe1.Write(Ustmargin, 60, 5, 15,"RESMÝ")
	res = pe1.Line(Ustmargin+5, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)
	
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)

	StokKodu = LISTET.KOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	StokAdi2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")

	res=pe1.setrotation (0)
	Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dd", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & StokKodu & "'", "", -1)
	Resim = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & trim(S0P.FULLFILENAME1)

	uzunluk = 40
	satirAra = 4.5

	'res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(180,180,180))
	'res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.Write(Ust+10, 15, 5, 40, "[ " & trim(StokKodu) & " ]")

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.Picture(Ust+6, 60, 10, 20,trim(Resim), 16)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 90, 4, 33, "ÖPS STOKADI-1 : ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4, 70, trim(StokAdi))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop+6, 90, 4, 33, "ÖPS STOKADI-2 : ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4, 70,trim(StokAdi2))
	res = pe1.Line(ust+18, solMargin, 0 , sagMargin - solMargin)

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	SolMargin = 65

	SatirSayisi = STOK67T.GetCurrentRow()


	For i=SatirSayisi To SatirSayisi

		StokKodu = STOK67T.KOD(i)

		MamulGroup3adi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_3",StokKodu,-1)

		MIKTAR = STOK67T.SF_MIKTAR
		Birim = STOK67T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
		PARTINO = STOK67T.LOTNUMBER(i)
		TARIH = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK67E.TARIH)

		Musteri = STOK67E.CH_KODU
		MusteriAdi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", Musteri, "")
		MusteriStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu, Musteri)
		MusteriStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(StokKodu, Musteri)
		
		resim = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu +"000001", "EVRAKNO+TRNUM"))

		res = pe1.nopen()
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+10, solmargin+83, 10, 15,trim(Resim), 16)
		res = pe1.Picture(UST+50,solmargin+80,20,20,Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & "opsok.jpg", 16)
		P = 6	
		j=4

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 11)

		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+24-j, solmargin+19,P, 83,	UCASE(trim(MUSTERIADI)))
		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+31.5-j, solmargin+3,P, 96,	UCASE(trim(MusteriStokKodu)) & " [ÖPS KOD:" & trim(StokKodu) & "]" )
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+39-j, solmargin+3,P, 95,	trim(MusteriStokAdi))

		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+48-j, solmargin+3,	P, 95,	trim(MIKTAR) & " " & trim(birim)) 

		If trim(MamulGroup3adi)="BPLAS" THEN 
		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+54-j, solmargin+20,	P, 81,	"CROM 6 ÝÇERMEMEKTEDÝR.") 
		End if
	
		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+62-j, solmargin+3,	P, 95,	trim(PARTINO))
		
		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+73-j, solmargin+93,	P, 10,	"X")

		res = pe1.Write(ustmargin+78-j, solmargin+3,	P, 95,	trim(TARIH))

		If i<SatirSayisi Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			res = pe1.Write(UstMargin-4, solMargin+40, 6, 60, "MALZEME TANITIM ETÝKETÝ")
		End if


	Next 
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

FUNCTION GetCHKodu(StokKodu)

	rows =  Doc.SelectEQ("STOK0GT", "STOKCODE", StokKodu)

	IF rows = 0 THEN

		GetCHKodu = "" 
		Exit Function

	END IF

	Set T_STOK0GT = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_STOK0GT_SELECT")

	GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)
	Exit Function

	IF T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount = 1 THEN

		GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(1)

	ELSEIF T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount > 1 THEN

		FOR i = 1 TO T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount()
			
			Firma = Firma & i & ". " & trim(T_STOK0GT.KOD(i)) & " - " & trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",T_STOK0GT.KOD(i),"")) & vbcrlf 
		
		NEXT

		k = inputbox(satirNo & ". satýr, Hangi firma için etiket basýlacak?" & vbcrlf & vbcrlf & Firma,"dinamo","1")
		k = 1

		IF Doc.cDbl(k) > 0 AND Doc.cDbl(k) <= T_STOK0GT.GetRecCount THEN

			GetCHKodu = T_STOK0GT.KOD(Doc.cDbl(k))

		ELSE

			GetCHKodu = ""

		END IF

	END IF

END FUNCTION

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)

	StokKodu = LISTET.KOD(satirNo)
	StokAdi = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
	StokAdi2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")
	GuvenlikStogu= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00", "B_GUVENLIKSTOGU", StokKodu, "")

	UrunAgaciFoyNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", StokKodu & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
	resim = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", StokKodu+"000001", "EVRAKNO+TRNUM")
		
  res = pe1.nopen()
	res=pe1.setrotation (270)
	res = res = pe1.Write(UST+5,5,10,20,"")
	res=pe1.setrotation (0)
	
En1 = 45
	satirAra = 4.5
	
	YaziSol = pe1.GetRight + 1
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, 6, 8, En1,"STOK KODU")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(StokKodu))

	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, 6, 5, En1,"STOK ADI")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, 6, 5, En1,"STOK ADI 2")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & StokAdi2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirAra, 6, 5, En1,"EMNÝYET STOK MÝKTARI")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, sagMargin - pe1.GetRight - 1,": " & trim(guvenlikstogu))

res = pe1.NoPen()
'res=pe1.setrotation (90)
res = pe1.Picture(Ust+5, 140, 10, 20,trim(Resim), 16)
'res=pe1.setrotation (0)


End Sub
