'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True

	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	Call DEGERLER ()

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI 
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.SafePack()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1)
		
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI & "(" & Trim(KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI)
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			For h=18 To 20 
				If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next
			
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
			For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'HAFTALAR (8 HAFTA)
			For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'AYLAR (4 AY)
			For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+ 1

				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'HAFTA SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, HAFTAKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'AY SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, AYKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,AYKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(16,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(17,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'DÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'BUGÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	BUGUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
		'HAFTA
	For y=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(y,2),"Hafta",1)>0 Then HAFTAKOLONSAYISI=y
	Next
		'AY
	For z=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(z,2),"Ay",1)>0 Then AYKOLONSAYISI=z
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'HAFTALAR(8 HAFTA)
	For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		KACINCIHAFTA = Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),4)
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KACINCIHAFTA & "H        " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	HAFTAKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'AYLAR (4 AY)
	For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
		YHARFINEKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), "y", 1)
		NOKTAYAKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), ".", 1)
		AYYAZ=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),YHARFINEKADAR))
		AYSAYISI=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),NOKTAYAKADAR-1))
		Select Case AYSAYISI
			Case "1" AY="Ocak"
			Case "2" AY="Þubat"
			Case "3" AY="Mart"
			Case "4" AY="Nisan"
			Case "5" AY="Mayýs"
			Case "6" AY="Haziran"
			Case "7" AY="Temmuz"
			Case "8" AY="Aðustos"
			Case "9" AY="Eylül"
			Case "10" AY="Ekim"
			Case "11" AY="Kasým"
			Case "12" AY="Aralýk"
		End Select				
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = AYYAZ & "            " & AY
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	AYKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO+1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ()

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub

Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	siraNo = 0
	sayfaNo = 0 

	sayfaBoyu = 147.5
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = sayfaBoyu - 10
	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 8.5
	SiraNo = 0

	sayfaSatirsayisi = 10
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Set S47T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK47T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK47E.EVRAKNO + "' & STATUS=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	S47T.Sort("STATUS")

	'Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("STOK47T")
	'TABLO.Sort("ACIKKAPALI<>K")
	
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Talebi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End IF

	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	Set S47T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK47T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK47E.EVRAKNO + "' & STATUS=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	S47T.Sort("STATUS")

	satirSayisi_tableT = S47T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
 
	res = pe1.Box(UstMargin, solMargin, 12, sagMargin - solMargin)
	DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_USTKONUM = pe1.GetTop
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Picture(pe1.GetTop+0.5, pe1.GetLeft+1, 14, 24, logo, 114)
	res = pe1.Line(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_USTKONUM, pe1.GetRight + 1, DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM-UstMargin, 0)

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 20)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.write(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_USTKONUM+2, pe1.GetLeft+1, 16, 120, "DIÞ SATINALMA TALEP FORMU")
	res = pe1.Line(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_USTKONUM, pe1.GetRight + 1, DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM-UstMargin, 0)
	DISSATINALMA_SOL_DIKCIZGI_SOLKONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	 
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "9")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	BBasla = UstMargin + 15
	SatirAra = 7
	Genislik10 = 27
	Genislik20 = 30

	FisNo = STOK47E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK47E.TARIH(1))
	TalepEdenBolum = STOK47E.CODEDBOLUM(1)
	TalepEdenBolumAdi = doc.GetGecoValue("DEPT","AD",TalepEdenBolum ,-1)
	TalepEdenKisi = STOK47E.CODEDKISI(1)  
	TalepEden = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("PERS00","AD",TalepEdenKisi,"")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop+1, pe1.GetLeft+1, 5, 20, "EVRAK NO")
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, 22, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+1, DISSATINALMA_SOL_DIKCIZGI_SOLKONUM + 1, 5, 20, "TARÝH")
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Evrak_Yazdirma_Tarihi= Doc.StrtoNordate(Doc.Bugun())
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop , pe1.GetRight + 1, 5, 22, ": " & Evrak_Yazdirma_Tarihi)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	'ALT BUYUK KUTU
	res = pe1.Box(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM, solmargin, altmargin-21.5, sagMargin - solMargin)
	'ALT BUYUK KUTU ALT KONUMU
	ALT_BUYUKKUTU_ALTKONUMU=pe1.GetBottom
	'ALT BUYUK KUTU UST KONUMU
	ALT_BUYUKKUTU_USTKONUMU=pe1.GetTop
	satirBaslangic = DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM + 1

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	Sol = solmargin + 1
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	'DIÞ SATINALAM TALEP FORMU ALTI BAÞLIKLAR
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		GENISLIK = 10
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			if i = 3 then
				Genislik = Grid(i,1) + Grid(i + 1,1)
				res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic, Sol, 4.5, 32, "ÝSTENÝLEN")
				res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic + 5,sol - 1, 0, 28)
				'MÝKTAR ÜSTKONUM
				Ust  = satirBaslangic + 5.5
				MIKTARUSTKONUM=Ust
				GENISLIK = 4.5
			elseif i = 4 then
				'TARÝH ÜSTKONUM
				Ust  = satirBaslangic + 5.5
				GENISLIK = 4.5
			elseif i =  1 THEN
				'ÝSTENÝLEN MALZEME TANIMI ÜST KONUM
				Ust  = satirBaslangic + 3
			elseif i =  5 THEN
				'TALEP EDEN BÖLÜM KÝÞÝ
				Ust  = satirBaslangic - 0.5
				GENISLIK = 11
			elseif i =  0 THEN
				'TALEP SIRA NO ÜST KONUM
				Ust  = satirBaslangic - 0.5
				GENISLIK = 11
			elseif i =  6 THEN
				'AÇIKLAMA
				Ust  = satirBaslangic + 3
				GENISLIK = 4.5
			else
				'ÝSTENÝLEN HARÝCÝNDEKÝ BAÞLIKLAR ÜSTKONUMU
				Ust  = satirBaslangic + 1
			end if
			res = pe1.write(Ust, Sol, GENISLIK, SutunGenisligi - 2, Baslik)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)) =	Sol - 1
			redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
		End If
	Next

	'BAÞLIK ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, solmargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	BASLIK_ALTI_YATAYCIZGI_KONUM=pe1.GetBottom
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

	Dim satirpozr
	if trim(STOK47T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" then exit sub
	SiraNo = SiraNo + 1
	sonSatir = ALT_BUYUKKUTU_ALTKONUMU
	satirBaslangic=pe1.GetBottom

	If SiraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = BASLIK_ALTI_YATAYCIZGI_KONUM + 0.5
		SiraNo = 1
		sayfaNo = sayfaNo + 1
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = BASLIK_ALTI_YATAYCIZGI_KONUM + 0.5
		Else
			satirpozr = BASLIK_ALTI_YATAYCIZGI_KONUM + ((siraNo - 1) * (satiryuksekligi))
		End If
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = solMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		If DegiskenAdi = "_CINS" then
			StokKodu = STOK47T.KOD(satirNo)
			Stokadi_1 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","AD",StokKodu,"")
			Stokadi_2 = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","NAME2",StokKodu,"")
			Degisken = trim(StokAdi_1) & " - " & trim(StokAdi_2)
		Elseif DegiskenAdi = "ARTNO" then
			res = pe1.SetBold(1)
			'SIRA NO ÝÇÝN 1,2,3 YAZDIRMA
			TalepNo= Trim(STOK47T.ARTNO(satirNo))
			Degisken = TalepNo &"    -"& SiraNo + sayfaNo * sayfaSatirSayisi
		Else
			Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK47T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		End If

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "CC" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If

		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			If DegiskenAdi = "SF_MIKTAR" then
				res = pe1.SetBold(1)
				'BÝRÝMÝ MÝKTARA YAZDIRMA
				BIRIM = Trim(STOK47T.SF_SF_UNIT(satirNo))
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi-2, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr+4, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi-2, SutunGenisligi - 1, BIRIM)
			Else
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi-2, SutunGenisligi - 1, Degisken)
			End If
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If	
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)

	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi)- 2
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		if i = 3 then
		'MÝKTAR SAÐI DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
		 res = pe1.Line(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM+6, LineX, ALT_BUYUKKUTU_ALTKONUMU-DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM-25.5, 0)
		else
		'MÝKTAR SAÐI HARÝCÝNDEKÝ DÝK ÇÝZGÝLER
		 res = pe1.Line(DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM, LineX, ALT_BUYUKKUTU_ALTKONUMU-DISSATINALMA_KUTUSU_ALTKONUM-19.5, 0)
		end if
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
	For i = 1 To sayfaSatirSayisi
		res = pe1.Line((BASLIK_ALTI_YATAYCIZGI_KONUM-1) + i * (satirYuksekligi), solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)	
	Next
	SATIRLAR_ALTI_ALT_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	

	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Notlar1 = STOK47E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1
	Notlar2 = STOK47E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, solMargin + 1,6,95,"HAZIRLAYAN : DEPO SORUMLUSU")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, solMargin + 1,6,95,"ÝMZA:")
	res = pe1.Line(SATIRLAR_ALTI_ALT_KONUM, pe1.GetRight+1, 19.5, 0)

	res = pe1.Write(SATIRLAR_ALTI_ALT_KONUM+2, pe1.GetRight + 1,6,90,"ONAYLAYAN : GENEL MÜDÜR")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, pe1.GetLeft,6,90,"ÝMZA:")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Write(ALT_BUYUKKUTU_ALTKONUMU+0.5, solmargin, 4, 90, "FR.07.04.03; Rev:02; 27.03.09")

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "ARTNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "_CINS"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "RTALEPEDILENTESTARIH"
	Grid(5,0) = "TESISKODU"
	Grid(6,0) = "NOTE0"
	Grid(7,0) = "_OK/RED"

	Grid(0,1) = 15
	Grid(1,1) = 67
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 14.5
	Grid(4,1) = 14
	Grid(5,1) = 14
	Grid(6,1) = 37
	Grid(7,1) = 9.2

	Grid(0,2) = "TALEP/SIRA NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÝSTENÝLEN MALZEMENÝN TANIMI"
	Grid(2,2) = "ÖPS STOK KODU"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "TARÝH"
	Grid(5,2) = "T.E. BÖLÜM /KÝÞÝ"
	Grid(6,2) = "AÇIKLAMA"
	Grid(7,2) = "OK RED"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "D"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "C"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" And Left(degisken,1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK47T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			If Ondalik > 2 Then Ondalik = 2
			Grid(i,7) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintLabel()
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) = "D1D4F" Then
		QStr = "SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.BuGun+"'"
		Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
		if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			QStr = "SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.StrDate_Increment(Doc.BuGun,-1)+"'"
			Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
			if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
				k = Doc.d7msgBox("Gölcük etiket iþlemleri için sevkiyat günü FOSN programý alýnmýþ olmaldýr.","dinamo",MB_OK)
				exit sub
			End if
		End if
	End if

	UreticiKodu = "AS3WA"
	Unvan = "ÖZEN PRES MAK.SAN.LTD.ÞTÝ."
	Adres = "TAYSAD ORG.SAN.BÖL.1.CD.16.YOL 6.PARSEL 41410 Þ.PINAR-GEBZE/KOCAELÝ"
'	Grade = "B"
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("YYYY", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	for i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)

'MUSTAFA				

			'AMBALAJKODU
		KonteynerKodu = Trim(GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI))
		KonteynerKodu = Trim(Mid(Trim(KonteynerKodu),5,8))

	'	KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		if trim(KonteynerKodu) = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if

'MUSTAFA

			'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
		STANDARTMIKTAR = GetStdKoliAdet(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)
		KUTUICIMIKTAR = STANDARTMIKTAR

	'	KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
	'	KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)

		if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " sandýk içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
'		exit sub
	end if

	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	if trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" then
		k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 18
	EtiketBoyu = 117
	EtiketEni = 171
	EtiketlerArasi = 143
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU

	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		if trim(S60T.KOD(i)) <> "" and Miktar > 0 then
			StokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
			CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)

'MUSTAFA

		'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
			STANDARTMIKTAR = GetStdKoliAdet(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)
			KUTUICIMIKTAR = STANDARTMIKTAR 

		'	KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		'	KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)

			if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
				EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
			end if

' ZZZ

			for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
				Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
				if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
					KutuMiktari = Kalan
				else
					KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
				end if

				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1

				ModEtiketNo = EtiketNo
		
'				if ModEtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
					Ust = UstMargin						
						if EtiketNo <> 1 then
							res = pe1.PageBreak()
						end if
'					else
'						Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
'				end if					
				Call Etiket(pe1,i, KutuMiktari)

			Next
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "YYYY"
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo, KutuMiktari)
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 47
	D2 = SolMargin + 87
	D3 = SolMargin + 121.5
	D4 = SolMargin + 125.5
	D5 = SolMargin + 139
	D6 = SolMargin + 158

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y1 = Ust + 12.5
	Y2 = Ust + 24
	Y3 = Ust + 35
	Y4 = Ust + 45.5
	Y5 = Ust + 56
	Y6 = Ust + 66
	Y7 = Ust + 79
	Y8 = Ust + 88
	Y9 = Ust + 98
	Y10 = Ust + 117

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(Ust,SolMargin, EtiketBoyu, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2,D2,0,sagMargin-D2)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4,D5,0,sagMargin-D5)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y6,D2,0,sagMargin-D2)
	res = pe1.Line(Y7,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y8,D2,0,sagMargin-D2)
	res = pe1.Line(Y9,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)

	res = pe1.Line(Y5,D1,Y9-Y5,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust,D2,Y3-Ust,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5,D2,Y10-Y5,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2,D3,Y3-Y2,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y8,D4,Y9-Y8,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Ust,D5,Y1-Ust,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3,D5,Y5-Y3,0)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2,D6,Y3-Y2,0)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU

' orhan

	AliciKod = TRIM(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)
	AliciAd =  doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",AliciKod,"")
	Alici = Trim(AliciKod) + "-" + Trim(AliciAd) 

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(Ust + 1.5, SolMargin + 2.5,4,20,"RECEIVER / ALICI")
	if len(Alici) >= 22 then
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",18)
	else
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",20)
	end if
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(Ust + 4.5, SolMargin,8,D2 - solMargin,trim(Alici))

	sol = D2
	sag = D5
	rUst = Ust
	StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirNo)
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
	CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)
'	Kapi = S60T.DOK(satirNo)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,4,sag - sol - 2.5,"DOCK / KAPI")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",18)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 4.5, sol,8,sag - sol,trim(Kapi))

	sol = D5
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Ust
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
'	Lokasyon = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_4",StokKodu,"")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,4,sag - sol - 2.5,"LOCATION / LOKASYON")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",18)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 4.5, sol,8,sag - sol,Lokasyon)

	sol = solMargin
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y1
	IrsaliyeNo = "A-" & right("00" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),7)
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(IrsaliyeNo)
	sol1 = sol + (sag - sol - BarkodGen) / 2
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,4,sag - sol - 2.5,"PACKING SLIP NO/IRSALIYE NO(N)")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",11)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+10,sol1,11,BarkodGen,"CODE39","N" & trim(IrsaliyeNo) & "","")

	sol = D2
	sag = sagMargin

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 4.5, sol,8,sag - sol,"")
	
	sol = solMargin
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y9

	SeriNo = UreticiKodu & EtiketNo

	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(SeriNo)
	sol1 = sol + (sag - sol - BarkodGen) / 2
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,4,sag - sol - 2.5,"SERIAL NO / SERÝ NO (S)")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",11)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 3.5, sol,8,sag - sol,SeriNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+8,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE39","S" & SeriNo & "","")

	sol = D2
	sag = sagMargin
	rUst = Y9
	PartiNo = trim(S60T.LOTNUMBER(satirNo))
	BarkodGen = Barkodgenisligi(PartiNo)
	sol1 = sol + (sag - sol - BarkodGen) / 2
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",4)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,4,sag - sol - 2.5,"BATCH NUMBER / PARTÝ NUMARASI (H)")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",11)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 3.5, sol,8,sag - sol,PartiNo)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
	if trim(PartiNo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Barcode(rUst+8,sol1,10,BarkodGen,"CODE39","H" & PartiNo & "","")
	End if
End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
	QStr = "KOD='"+StokKodu+"'&SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&ACIKKAPALI='A'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.BuGun+"'"
	Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
	if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
		GetFordLokasyon = ""
	Else
		GetFordLokasyon = OSP1L.LOKASYON(1)
	End if
	Doc.DeletetableObject "XXX"
End Function

Function GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasaKodu = ""
	Else
		GetKasaKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GETSTDKOLIADET(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasa = ""
	Else
		GetStdKoliAdet = Trim(S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

	siraNo = 0
	siraNo1 = 0
	
	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", 140, 215, "")

	satiryuksekligi= 5
	Ustmargin = 5
	satirBaslangic = ustmargin +35
	sayfasonu=85
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 10
	solmargin = 15
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK26T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)

	
	
	aciklama1=STOK26E.FORW_TEXT1(1)	
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK26E.TARIH)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 120, SolMargin + 135, satiryuksekligi, 30,tarih)
	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 5, SolMargin + 155, satiryuksekligi, 30,trim(aciklama1))

	
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK26T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonsatir > sayfasonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

		res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin 		
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			

			Select Case trim(degiskenAdi)
				case "_SIRANO"
					sirano1=satirno+1 
					Degisken=sirano			
				case else
					Degisken = STOK26T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			end select
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat_nlz(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	


End Sub

Sub Alanlar()

	ReDim Grid(6, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "_SIRANO"

	Grid(3, 0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4, 0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5, 0) = "LOTNUMBER"
	


	
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 70
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 35
	
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = STOK26T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("ddeett", "STOK60T", "", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")

	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	siraNo = 0

	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 215.9
	satiryuksekligi = 8.3

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(88)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

	'ustmargin = 120
	satirBaslangic = 110
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 25
	solmargin = 15
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	BayrakSatirAtla = 0 

	Call Alanlar()

	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi

		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)

	Next

	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)
	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)

	if trim(STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1) = "" then
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	else
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	end if

	vergidairesi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGIDAIRESI(1)
	vergino = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGINO(1)
	tarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))

	If trim(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH) = "" Then

		sevktarih = Tarih

	Else

		sevktarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH)

	End If

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(180,180,180))

	res = pe1.write(63 , solmargin + 5, 3.5, 80, trim(chadi))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop + 8, solMargin + 5, 3.5, 80 , trim(adres1))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop + 4, pe1.GetLeft, 3.5, 80 , trim(adres2))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop + 8, pe1.GetLeft, 3.5, 80 , trim(adres3))

	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop + 6, solmargin + 30, 3.5, 43, trim(vergidairesi) & "     " & trim(vergino))

	res = pe1.write(80, solmargin + 160, 3.5, 30, trim(sevktarih))
	res = pe1.write(93, solmargin + 160, 3.5, 30, trim(tarih))

End Sub

'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)

		Dim satirpozr

		If trim(S60T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub

		Degisken = ""

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

		If siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then

			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic

		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1

		satirpozr = (satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi)-4

		If BayrakSatiratla = 1 Then

			satirpozr = satirpozr + 6.3

		End If

		res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin + 5
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		FOR i = 0 TO UBound(Grid,1)

			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

			StokKodu = S60T.KOD(satirno)		

			SELECT CASE trim(degiskenAdi)

				CASE "_MKOD"

					MStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)

					IF trim(MStokKodu) = "" THEN

						degisken = S60T.KOD(satirno)

					ELSE

						degisken = MStokKodu

					END IF

				CASE "_MAD"

						MStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)

						IF trim(MStokAdi) = "" THEN

							degisken = S60T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirno)

						ELSE

							degisken = MStokAdi

						END IF

				CASE "_TEXT1"
					

					IF TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-036" OR TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-129" THEN
			
						IF trim(StokKodu)="MON-00067" THEN 					'YC15 V28362 AA parçasý

							degisken="PM-002"
						
						ELSE

							degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")

						END IF

					ELSE

						IF sevkadresi="AUF9A" THEN	
						
							degisken=""

						ELSE

							degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
						
						END IF		

					END IF			

				CASE "_NUM1"

					BrutAgirlik = S60T.BRUTAGIRLIK(satirno)

					IF TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-036" OR TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-129" THEN
			
						IF trim(StokKodu)="MON-00067" THEN 					'YC15 V28362 AA parçasý
						
							PaketMiktari=300
							degisken=PaketMiktari

						ELSE

							degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")						
		
						END IF


					ELSE

						IF sevkadresi="AUF9A" THEN

							degisken = ""

						ELSE

							degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")	
					
						END IF

					END IF

				CASE "_SAYI"

					IF TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-036" OR TRIM(chkodu)="120-01-129" THEN
			
						IF trim(StokKodu)="MON-00067" THEN 					'YC15 V28362 AA parçasý
						
							KutuIciMiktar=300
							ToplamMiktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
							KutuSayisi = Doc.Div(ToplamMiktar, KutuIciMiktar)
								
								IF KutuSayisi> 0 THEN

									degisken = KutuSayisi	

								ELSE

									degisken = ""	

								END IF

						ELSE

							KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")	
							ToplamMiktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
							KutuSayisi = Doc.Div(ToplamMiktar, KutuIciMiktar)

							IF KutuSayisi> 0 THEN

								degisken = KutuSayisi	

							ELSE

								degisken = ""	

							END IF

						END IF

					ELSE

						IF sevkadresi="AUF9A" THEN
					
							KutuIciMiktar = ""	
							ToplamMiktar = ""
							KutuSayisi = ""

						ELSE

							KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")	
							ToplamMiktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(satirno)
							KutuSayisi = Doc.Div(ToplamMiktar, KutuIciMiktar)

							IF KutuSayisi> 0 THEN

								degisken = KutuSayisi	

							ELSE

								degisken = ""	

							END IF

						END IF

					END IF

				CASE ELSE

					Degisken = S60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)

			END SELECT

			IF Grid(i,4) = "N" THEN

				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))

			ELSEIF Grid(i,4) = "D" THEN

				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)

			END IF

			IF TRIM(S60T.FATURASIZMI(SatirNo))="E" THEN

				IF BayrakSatirAtla = 0 THEN

					BayrakSatirAtla = 1
					satirpozr = satirpozr + 6.3

				END IF

			END IF
			
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr+12, sol-2, satiryuksekligi, sutunGenisligi - 2, trim(Degisken))
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1

		NEXT					 

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

END SUB

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

END SUB

Public k,OTSP,Sheet,OTSP1,GununTarihi,j,Wb,ddd,KAYITSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,KAYITSTARTSATIRI,KAYITSTARTKOLONU,TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI

Public GUNKOLONSONU,BASLIKBASLANGICSATIRNO,BASLIKBASLANGICKOLONNO,HAFTAKOLONSONU,AYKOLONSONU,SEVKSATIR_ARR(10)

Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True

	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	Call DEGERLER ()

	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")

	For b=1 To TABLO.GetRowCount
			'SEVK ADRES ADI
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",Trim(TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(b)),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",Trim(TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(b)),"")
		SEVK_KODU = "(" & Trim(TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(b)) & "/" & TRIM(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) & ")-" & SEVK_KODU 
	Next 
		'SEVK KODLARI MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(4, 1), Sheet.Cells(4, 21)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(4, 1).Value = SEVK_KODU
	Sheet.Cells(4, 1).Select
	k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
	k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO,GUNDEGER

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.SafePack()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KODA GÖRE SIRALA
	TABLO.Sort("KOD")
	
	PARCAKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To PARCAKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("KOD")
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		Doc.StatusBarMessage i & " / " & TABLO.GetRecCount()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(TABLO.KOD(u)) & " (" & Trim(TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)) & ")"
		MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",TABLO.KOD(u),-1))
		KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(TABLO.KOD(u)),-1)
		
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI & " (" & Trim(KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI) & ")"
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		GECENGUNDEGERTOPLAMI = 0
		For h=18 To 20 
			If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
			If TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), u) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), u)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			GECENGUNDEGER = TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), u)
			GECENGUNDEGERTOPLAMI = GECENGUNDEGERTOPLAMI+GECENGUNDEGER
		Next
			
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

			'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
		GUNDEGERTOPLAMI = 0
		For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
			If TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), u) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), u)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
				'TÜM GÜN SATIRI 0 ÝSE SATIRI SÝL
			GUNDEGER = TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), u)
			GUNDEGERTOPLAMI = GUNDEGERTOPLAMI+GUNDEGER
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		Next

		If GUNDEGERTOPLAMI = 0 AND GECENGUNDEGERTOPLAMI = 0 Then 
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
			k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 3 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO - 1
		Else
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), u) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = TABLO.GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), u)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = TABLO.KOD(u)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
  				RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
		End If
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SUTUNNO = 2
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
'		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
'			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
'			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
'			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
'		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

'			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
'		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
'			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
'			k.Selection.Copy
'			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
'			Sheet.Paste
'		End If
	Next
	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO + 1
	Call MAKYAJ
	
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(16,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(17,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'DÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'BUGÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	BUGUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "      " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
	
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="_"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ()

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 22
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

End Sub

Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 1
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 70
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintLabel1(TABLO)
	Set MAINTABLET= Doc.GetTableObject(TABLO)
	SAYAC=0
	v=0
	Call PrintLabel()
End Sub

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub CERCEVE_KONUM ()
	'SARI ALANDAN MESAFE	
	USTMARGIN_DISTAN = 2
	SOLMARGIN_DISTAN = 2
	SAGMARGIN_DISTAN = 2
	ALTMARGIN_DISTAN = 2

	'ETÝKETTEN MESAFE		
	USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN=5
	SOLMARGIN_ETIKETTEN=16
	SAGMARGIN_ETIKETTEN=3
	ALTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN=3
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintLabel()
	USTKONUMKOLTUKALTI=0 
	FLAGSAYAC=0
	ETIKETNO= 0
	SONSATIR=200

	SERINOX = Trim(MainTableT.SERINO(1))

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Set D7LX = Doc.Select1("DSDFWEF", "D7KIDSLB", "SERINO='"+SERINOX+"'", "", -1)
	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="TRMDEPO" Or KULLANICI="TRMURTM" Then
		If Doc.GetDocType="STOK25" Or Doc.GetDocType="TRACK25" Then
			If Trim(D7LX.REFTEXT502) <> "" Then 
				MsgBox "MPS DEN YENÝ BARKOD ÝLE DEÐÝÞTÝR!" 
				Exit Sub
			End If
		End If
	End IF
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="T" Or KULLANICI="FEVZI" Or KULLANICI="BAKIM" Then

		If KULLANICI="T" Then 	
			AYARSEC=InputBox ("1-DEPO BKOD, 2-ÜRTM BKOD, 3-LAZER","BÖLÜM ETÝKET AYARI ALMA","2")
		Else
			AYARSEC=InputBox ("1-DEPO BKOD, 2-ÜRTM BKOD, 3-LAZER","BÖLÜM ETÝKET AYARI ALMA","3")
		End If
		
		If AYARSEC="" Then Exit Sub
		If AYARSEC="1" Then  
			KULLANICI="TRMDEPO"
		End If
	End IF
	'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="TRMDEPO" Then
		ETIKETSEC 	= 3
		SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY=1
		SAYFABOYU 	= 75+4
		SAYFAENI = 160+4
	Else	
	
		'etiket tipi
		 
		ETIKETSEC=D7LX.REFNUM10

		If ETIKETSEC	=	"3" Then		
			SAYFABOYU 	= 180 '(160)
			SAYFAENI = 100  '(80)
		Else
			SAYFABOYU 	= 1
			SAYFAENI 		= 1
		End If
	End If 
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY=InputBox ("1- DÝKEY, 2- PARALEL","SAYFA YATAY/PARALEL","2")
	SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY=1
	If SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY = "" Then Exit Sub
	If SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY	=	1 Then YATAYDIKEY="Portrait"
	If SAYFA_YATAYDIKEY	=	2 Then YATAYDIKEY="Landscape"
	res = pe1.Open(0, "ETIKET", SAYFABOYU, SAYFAENI, YATAYDIKEY)
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call CERCEVE_KONUM()
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KUTU ÇÝZER
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=USTMARGIN_DISTAN+USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN
	KUTUSOLDANMESAFE=SOLMARGIN_DISTAN+SOLMARGIN_ETIKETTEN
	KUTUSAGDANMESAFE=SAGMARGIN_DISTAN+SAGMARGIN_ETIKETTEN
	KUTUALTTANMESAFE=ALTMARGIN_DISTAN+ALTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KUTUGENISLIGI	= 76
	KUTUYUKSEKLIGI =	146
	
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI="T" Or KULLANICI="Y" Then

		If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK25" Or Doc.GetDocType = "STOKFR2" Or Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK25" Then
			If Trim(D7LX.reftext06) = "E-BÝRLEÞME" Then
				For i = 1 To MAINTABLET.GetRecCount()
					MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
					If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
					res=pe1.SetDevice("SATO_URETIM")
					'sayfa yüksekliðini ayarlar
					res=pe1.SetDevPaperHeight(	SAYFABOYU)
					'sayfa geniþliðini ayarlar
					res=pe1.SetDevPaperWidth(SAYFAENI)
					Call ETIKET(pe1,i,MIKTAR,ETIKETADEDI)
				Next 
				res=pe1.PrintDoc(0)
				Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
			Else
				'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'ETIKETBOLME_ETK_SAYISI=InputBox ("1- Çoklu ETIKET, 2- TEKLÝ","ETÝKET BÖLMEDE ÇIKTI SAYILARI","1")
				'If ETIKETBOLME_ETK_SAYISI="" Then Exit Sub
				ETIKETBOLME_ETK_SAYISI="1"
				If Left(Trim(ETIKETBOLME_ETK_SAYISI),1)="1" Then
					For i = 1 To MAINTABLET.GetRecCount()
						MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
						If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
						Call ETIKET(pe1,i, MIKTAR, ETIKETADEDI)
					Next 
				ElseIf Left(Trim(ETIKETBOLME_ETK_SAYISI),1)="2" Then			
					'TEKLÝ ETÝKET BASIMI
					For i = 1 To 1
						MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
						If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
						Call ETIKET(pe1,i, MIKTAR, ETIKETADEDI)
					Next 
				End If
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				If ETIKETSEC="1" Or ETIKETSEC="2" Then
					res=pe1.SetDevice("\\fevzi\hp LaserJet 1010 Series Driver") 
					'A5 KAÐIT SEÇÝMÝ
					res = pe1.SetDevPaperFormat(-14)
				Else
					'res=pe1.SetDevice("SATO MAMUL")
					'res=pe1.SetDevice("Oki ML3321")
					'sayfa yüksekliðini ayarlar
					res=pe1.SetDevPaperHeight(	SAYFABOYU)
					'sayfa geniþliðini ayarlar
					res=pe1.SetDevPaperWidth(SAYFAENI)
				End If
				res = pe1.PrintDoc(0)
				Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
			End If
		End If
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	ElseIf KULLANICI="ADMIN" Or KULLANICI="DEPO" Or KULLANICI="FEVZÝ" Or KULLANICI="BAKIM" Then

		For i = 1 To MAINTABLET.GetRecCount()
			MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
			If ETIKETSEC =	"3" Then 
				If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
				'res=pe1.SetDevice("SATO_URETIM")

				res=pe1.SetDevice("Oki ML3321")
					'sayfa yüksekliðini ayarlar
				res=pe1.SetDevPaperHeight(	SAYFABOYU)
					'sayfa geniþliðini ayarlar
				res=pe1.SetDevPaperWidth(SAYFAENI)
			ElseIf ETIKETSEC =	"1" Or ETIKETSEC =	"2"  Then 
				If USTKONUMKOLTUKALTI > 170 Then 'SONSATIR Then
					pe1.PageBreak
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=USTMARGIN_DISTAN+USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN	
				ElseIf	USTKONUMKOLTUKALTI < 100 Then
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=USTMARGIN_DISTAN+USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN	
				Else
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=KUTUUSTTENMESAFE+100
				End If
					'A5 KAÐIT SEÇÝMÝ
				res = pe1.SetDevPaperFormat(-14)
			End If
			Call ETIKET(pe1,i,MIKTAR,ETIKETADEDI)
		Next 

		res = pe1.Show()
		res=pe1.PrintDoc(0)
		Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	ElseIf 	KULLANICI="TRMDEPO" Or KULLANICI="DEPO" Then
		For i = 1 To MAINTABLET.GetRecCount()
			MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
			If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
			Call ETIKET(pe1,i, MIKTAR, ETIKETADEDI)
		Next 	
		res=pe1.SetDevice("SATO MAMUL")
			'sayfa yüksekliðini ayarlar
		res=pe1.SetDevPaperHeight(	SAYFABOYU)
			'sayfa geniþliðini ayarlar
		res=pe1.SetDevPaperWidth(SAYFAENI)
		res=pe1.PrintDoc(0)
		Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
		'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Else
		For i = 1 To MAINTABLET.GetRecCount()
			MIKTAR = MAINTABLET.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
			If ETIKETSEC =	"3" Then 
				If i <> 1 Then res = pe1.PageBreak
			ElseIf ETIKETSEC	= "1" Or ETIKETSEC =	"2" Then 
				If USTKONUMKOLTUKALTI > 170 Then 'SONSATIR Then
					pe1.PageBreak
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=USTMARGIN_DISTAN+USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN	
				ElseIf	USTKONUMKOLTUKALTI < 100 Then
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=USTMARGIN_DISTAN+USTMARGIN_ETIKETTEN	
				Else
					KUTUUSTTENMESAFE=KUTUUSTTENMESAFE+100
				End If
			End If
				Call ETIKET(pe1,i,MIKTAR,ETIKETADEDI)
		Next 
			'A5 KAÐIT SEÇÝMÝ
		res = pe1.SetDevPaperFormat(-14)
		res = pe1.Show()
		Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
	End If

End Sub

'*************************** ETIKET ************************************************************
