'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True
	
	k.ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
	
	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	Call DEGERLER ()

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI 
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.SafePack()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)

		For i = 1 To SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
			If PUNTAMI <> "PUNTA" Then SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i) = ""
		Next

		SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).SafePack
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "SEVK KODU= " & SEVKKODU_ARR(u) & " - " & "KAYITLAR= " & i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
		
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI 
			If Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			For h=19 To 20 
				If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next
			
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
			For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'HAFTALAR (8 HAFTA)
			For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'AYLAR (4 AY)
			For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+ 1

				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'HAFTA SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, HAFTAKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'AY SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, AYKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,AYKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(16,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(17,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'KAYNAK - MONTAJ BÝLGÝSÝ
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "K-M" 
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'BUGÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	BUGUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
		'HAFTA
	For y=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(y,2),"Hafta",1)>0 Then HAFTAKOLONSAYISI=y
	Next
		'AY
	For z=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(z,2),"Ay",1)>0 Then AYKOLONSAYISI=z
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'HAFTALAR(8 HAFTA)
	For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		KACINCIHAFTA = Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),4)
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KACINCIHAFTA & "H        " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	HAFTAKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'AYLAR (4 AY)
	For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
		YHARFINEKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), "y", 1)
		NOKTAYAKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), ".", 1)
		AYYAZ=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),YHARFINEKADAR))
		AYSAYISI=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),NOKTAYAKADAR-1))
		Select Case AYSAYISI
			Case "1" AY="Ocak"
			Case "2" AY="Þubat"
			Case "3" AY="Mart"
			Case "4" AY="Nisan"
			Case "5" AY="Mayýs"
			Case "6" AY="Haziran"
			Case "7" AY="Temmuz"
			Case "8" AY="Aðustos"
			Case "9" AY="Eylül"
			Case "10" AY="Ekim"
			Case "11" AY="Kasým"
			Case "12" AY="Aralýk"
		End Select				
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = AYYAZ & "            " & AY
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	AYKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam           Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO+1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub

Sub MAKYAJ()

	Doc.StatusBarMessage i & "Kayýtlar Düzenleniyor, ÝÞLEM DEVAM EDÝYOR !"

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90

	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE

		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge

	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn

		Sheet.Columns(i).Select

		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next

		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn

	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge

	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI

 	k.Rows("5:5").Select
	k.Selection.Copy
	k.Rows("4:4").Select
	k.Selection.Insert
	k.Rows("6:6").Select

	k.Visible = True

	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub

Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = "KYN1=V347/8 KAYNAK, KYN2=V184 KAYNAK, KYN3=V227 KAYNAK"
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = "MNT1=V347/8 MONTAJ, MNT2=V184 MONTAJ, MNT3=V227 MONTAJ"
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.1)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.25)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 58
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$4"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True
	
	'k.Calculation = 0
	'k.ScreenUpdating = False

	k.ActiveWindow.Zoom = 70
	
	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRN

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	'Call DEGERLER ()

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK40T")

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'MÜÞTERÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MÜÞTERÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(4,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(5,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK KODU-ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SADECE AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set UZUNVADETABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	UZUNVADETABLOSU.GroupBy("RTESTARIH")
	UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI = UZUNVADETABLOSU.GetRowCount

		'ÝCMAL ÝÇÝN TÜM KODLARA MON-00101 YAZDIRMA ÝÞLEMÝ
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
		UZUNVADETABLOSU.KOD(i) = Doc.LeftJustify("MON-00101",24)
	Next

	UZUNVADETABLOSU.SafePack()	

		'TARÝHLERÝ ALMA ve YAZMA
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = UZUNVADETABLOSU.RTESTARIH(i)
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

		'AÇIKCSÝPARÝÞLERDEKÝ SEVK ADRES SAYISI
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.GroupBy("SHIPTOCODE")
	SEVKADRESSAYISI = SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.GetRecCount()
	For p = 1 To SEVKADRESSAYISI
		SEVKADRESLERI_ARR(p) = SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.SHIPTOCODE(p)
	Next

		'SADECE AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLERDEKÝ MÜÞTERÝ KODLARI
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set ACIKSIPTABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	ACIKSIPTABLOSU.GroupBy("MUSTERIKODU")
	MUSTERIADETI = ACIKSIPTABLOSU.GetRecCount()
	
 
		'ÝCMAL ÝÇÝN TÜM KODLARA ÖYLESÝNE TARIH YAZMA YAZDIRMA ÝÞLEMÝ
	For m = 1 To MUSTERIADETI 
		XTARIH = Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.Bugun())			
		ACIKSIPTABLOSU.RTESTARIH(m) = XTARIH
		ACIKSIPTABLOSU.KOD(m) = Doc.LeftJustify("MON-00101",24)
		MUSTERIKODU_ARR(m) = ACIKSIPTABLOSU.MUSTERIKODU(m)
	Next

	For r = 1 To MUSTERIADETI 
			'AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER MÜÞTERÝKODUNA KODA GÖRE SIRALI
		'QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' & MUSTERIKODU = '" + MUSTERIKODU_ARR(r) + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + SEVKADRESLERI_ARR(p) + "'"
		QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' & MUSTERIKODU = '" + MUSTERIKODU_ARR(r) + "'"

		Set MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "KOD+SHIPTOCODE", -1)

		For i = 1 To MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).GetRowCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i)),-1))
			'If PUNTAMI = "PUNTA" Then 
				SUTUNNO = 2
				SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			
				If i = 1 Then 
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i)))
					CARIKODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
				Else 
					If Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i))) = Sheet.Cells(CARIKODSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i)))
						CARIKODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If
			
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				If i = 1 Then 
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i))
					KODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else 
					If Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i)) = Sheet.Cells(KODSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i))	
						KODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1	
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	
				If i = 1 Then 
					k.Selection.Value = MAMULADI
					MAMULSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else 
					If MAMULADI = Sheet.Cells(MAMULSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						k.Selection.Value = MAMULADI
						MAMULSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
				SEVKFABRIKAADI1	= Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i),""))
				SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i),""))

				If i = 1 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & Left(SEVKFABRIKAADI2,7)		
					SEVKSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else
					If Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & Left(SEVKFABRIKAADI2,7) = Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then
						If Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value <> "" Then
							Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & Left(SEVKFABRIKAADI2,7)	
							SEVKSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
						Else
							Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "" 
							SATIRNO = SATIRNO - 1
						End If
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & Left(SEVKFABRIKAADI2,7)			
						SEVKSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If	

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
					'EXCELDEKÝ TARÝH ÝLE SÝSTEMDEKÝ TARÝH EÞÝT ÝSE MÝKTARI YAZ
'				TESLIMTARIHI = MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).RTESTARIH(i)
'				TESLIMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(TESLIMTARIHI)
'				TESLIMTARIHI = Replace(TESLIMTARIHI, "/","")
'				For j = 5 To 5+UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
'					Sheet.Cells(5, j).Select
'					EXCELTARIH = Sheet.Cells(5, j).Value
'					EXCELTARIH = Doc.StrToNorDate(EXCELTARIH)	
'					EXCELTARIH = Replace(EXCELTARIH , "/","")
'					If TESLIMTARIHI = EXCELTARIH Then
'						Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIRKONUMU, j).Value = MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SF_MIKTAR(i)
'						SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'					End If
'				Next
			'End If
		Next 
	Next

		'SADECE AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set UZUNVADETABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	UZUNVADETABLOSU.GroupBy("RTESTARIH")
	UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI = UZUNVADETABLOSU.GetRowCount

		'ÝCMAL ÝÇÝN TÜM KODLARA MON-00101 YAZDIRMA ÝÞLEMÝ
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
		UZUNVADETABLOSU.KOD(i) = Doc.LeftJustify("MON-00101",24)
	Next

	UZUNVADETABLOSU.SafePack()	

		'TARÝHLERÝ ALMA ve YAZMA
	SUTUNNO = 6
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
		TTARIH = UZUNVADETABLOSU.RTESTARIH(i)
		TTARIH = Doc.StrToNorDate(TTARIH)			

		ddd.SetDate(Trim(TTARIH))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(5, SUTUNNO).Value = GUN & "          " & TTARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next


END SUB
'---------------------------------------------------------
SUB XXx()	

EXIT SUB

		UZUNVADE.SAFEPACK
		MSGBOX UZUNVADE.GETROWCOUNT()
		
	For i = 1 To TABLOX.GetRowCount()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = TABLOX.RTESTARIH(i)
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(5,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(5,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
		'HAFTA
	For y=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(y,2),"Hafta",1)>0 Then HAFTAKOLONSAYISI=y
	Next
		'AY
	For z=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(z,2),"Ay",1)>0 Then AYKOLONSAYISI=z
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'HAFTALAR(8 HAFTA)
	For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		KACINCIHAFTA = Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),4)
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KACINCIHAFTA & "H        " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	HAFTAKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'AYLAR (4 AY)
	For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
		YHARFINEKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), "y", 1)
		NOKTAYAKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), ".", 1)
		AYYAZ=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),YHARFINEKADAR))
		AYSAYISI=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),NOKTAYAKADAR-1))
		Select Case AYSAYISI
			Case "1" AY="Ocak"
			Case "2" AY="Þubat"
			Case "3" AY="Mart"
			Case "4" AY="Nisan"
			Case "5" AY="Mayýs"
			Case "6" AY="Haziran"
			Case "7" AY="Temmuz"
			Case "8" AY="Aðustos"
			Case "9" AY="Eylül"
			Case "10" AY="Ekim"
			Case "11" AY="Kasým"
			Case "12" AY="Aralýk"
		End Select				
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = AYYAZ & "            " & AY
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	AYKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam           Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO+1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub

'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI 
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK40T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK40T")
	TABLO.Sort("RTESTARIH")
	TABLO.SafePack()
	MSGBOX TABLO.KOD(1)
	
'	MSGBOX TABLO.GETROWCOUNT()

EXIT SUB
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)

		For i = 1 To SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
			If PUNTAMI <> "PUNTA" Then SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i) = ""
		Next

		SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).SafePack
		MSGBOX SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
		
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "SEVK KODU= " & SEVKKODU_ARR(u) & " - " & "KAYITLAR= " & i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
		
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI 
			If Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			For h=19 To 20 
				If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next
			
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
			For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'HAFTALAR (8 HAFTA)
			For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'AYLAR (4 AY)
			For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+ 1

				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'HAFTA SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, HAFTAKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'AY SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, AYKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,AYKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ()

	Doc.StatusBarMessage i & "Kayýtlar Düzenleniyor, ÝÞLEM DEVAM EDÝYOR !"

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK BAÞLIÐINI BAÞLIK ALTINA KOPYALA-YAZDIRIRKEN HER SAYFADA GÖRÜNMESÝ ÝÇÝN
 	k.Rows("5:5").Select
	k.Selection.Copy
	k.Rows("4:4").Select
	k.Selection.Insert
	k.Rows("6:6").Select
	k.Selection.Delete
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = "KYN1=V347/8 KAYNAK, KYN2=V184 KAYNAK, KYN3=V227 KAYNAK"
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = "MNT1=V347/8 MONTAJ, MNT2=V184 MONTAJ, MNT3=V227 MONTAJ"
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.1)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.25)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 58
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$4"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True
	
	k.ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
	
	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRN

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	'Call DEGERLER ()

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK40T")
	'ESKITABLOX.Sort("<RTESTARIH")
	'ESKITABLOX.GroupBy("RTESTARIH")	
	'ESKITABLOX.SafePAck

	'TABLOX.SAFEPACK

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'MÜÞTERÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MÜÞTERÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(4,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(5,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK KODU-ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SADECE AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set UZUNVADETABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	UZUNVADETABLOSU.GroupBy("RTESTARIH")
	UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI = UZUNVADETABLOSU.GetRowCount

		'ÝCMAL ÝÇÝN TÜM KODLARA MON-00101 YAZDIRMA ÝÞLEMÝ
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU.GetRowCount
		UZUNVADETABLOSU.KOD(i) = Doc.LeftJustify("MON-00101",24)
	Next

	UZUNVADETABLOSU.SafePack()	

		'TARÝHLERÝ ALMA ve YAZMA
	For i = 1 To UZUNVADETABLOSU.GetRowCount
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = UZUNVADETABLOSU.RTESTARIH(i)
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
		'AÇIKCSÝPARÝÞLERDEKÝ SEVK ADRES SAYISI
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.GroupBy("SHIPTOCODE")
	SEVKADRESSAYISI = SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.GetRecCount()
	For p = 1 To SEVKADRESSAYISI
		SEVKADRESLERI_ARR(p) = SEVKKODUTABLOSULOSU.SHIPTOCODE(p)
	Next

		'SADECE AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLERDEKÝ MÜÞTERÝ KODLARI
	QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K'"
	Set ACIKSIPTABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "RTESTARIH", -1)
	ACIKSIPTABLOSU.GroupBy("MUSTERIKODU")
	MUSTERIADETI = ACIKSIPTABLOSU.GetRecCount()
	
 
		'ÝCMAL ÝÇÝN TÜM KODLARA ÖYLESÝNE TARIH YAZMA YAZDIRMA ÝÞLEMÝ
	For m = 1 To MUSTERIADETI 
		XTARIH = Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.Bugun())			
		ACIKSIPTABLOSU.RTESTARIH(m) = XTARIH
		ACIKSIPTABLOSU.KOD(m) = Doc.LeftJustify("MON-00101",24)
		MUSTERIKODU_ARR(m) = ACIKSIPTABLOSU.MUSTERIKODU(m)
	Next

	For r = 1 To MUSTERIADETI 
			'AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER MÜÞTERÝKODUNA KODA GÖRE SIRALI
		'QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' & MUSTERIKODU = '" + MUSTERIKODU_ARR(r) + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + SEVKADRESLERI_ARR(p) + "'"
		QQQ = "ACIKKAPALI <> 'K' & MUSTERIKODU = '" + MUSTERIKODU_ARR(r) + "'"

		Set MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK40T", QQQ, "KOD+SHIPTOCODE", -1)

		For i = 1 To MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).GetRowCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i)),-1))
			'If PUNTAMI = "PUNTA" Then 
				SUTUNNO = 2
				SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			
				If i = 1 Then 
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i)))
					CARIKODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
				Else 
					If Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i))) = Sheet.Cells(CARIKODSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim((MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).MUSTERIKODU(i)))
						CARIKODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If
			
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				If i = 1 Then 
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i))
					KODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else 
					If Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i)) = Sheet.Cells(KODSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).KOD(i))	
						KODSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1	
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	
				If i = 1 Then 
					k.Selection.Value = MAMULADI
					MAMULSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else 
					If MAMULADI = Sheet.Cells(MAMULSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						k.Selection.Value = MAMULADI
						MAMULSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
				SEVKFABRIKAADI1	= Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i),""))
				SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i),""))

				If i = 1 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & LEFT(SEVKFABRIKAADI1,7) & "-" & SEVKFABRIKAADI2		
					SEVKSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
				Else
					If Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & LEFT(SEVKFABRIKAADI1,7) & "-" & SEVKFABRIKAADI2 = Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIRKONUMU, SUTUNNO).Value Then 
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Else
						Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SHIPTOCODE(i)) & "-" & LEFT(SEVKFABRIKAADI1,7) & "-" & SEVKFABRIKAADI2		
						SEVKSATIRKONUMU = SATIRNO
					End If
				End If	

				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
					'EXCELDEKÝ TARÝH ÝLE SÝSTEMDEKÝ TARÝH EÞÝT ÝSE MÝKTARI YAZ
				TESLIMTARIHI = MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).RTESTARIH(i)
				TESLIMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(TESLIMTARIHI)
				TESLIMTARIHI = Replace(TESLIMTARIHI, "/","")
				For j = 5 To 5+UZUNVADETABLOSU_KAYITSAYISI
					Sheet.Cells(5, j).Select
					EXCELTARIH = Sheet.Cells(5, j).Value
					EXCELTARIH = Doc.StrToNorDate(EXCELTARIH)	
					EXCELTARIH = Replace(EXCELTARIH , "/","")
					If TESLIMTARIHI = EXCELTARIH Then
						Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIRKONUMU, j).Value = MUSTERIYEGORE_KODLAR(r).SF_MIKTAR(i)
						SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
					End If
				Next
			'End If
		Next 
	Next

END SUB

SUB XXx()	

EXIT SUB

		UZUNVADE.SAFEPACK
	
	For i = 1 To TABLOX.GetRowCount()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = TABLOX.RTESTARIH(i)
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(5,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(5,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
		'HAFTA
	For y=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(y,2),"Hafta",1)>0 Then HAFTAKOLONSAYISI=y
	Next
		'AY
	For z=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(z,2),"Ay",1)>0 Then AYKOLONSAYISI=z
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'HAFTALAR(8 HAFTA)
	For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		KACINCIHAFTA = Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),4)
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KACINCIHAFTA & "H        " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	HAFTAKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'AYLAR (4 AY)
	For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
		YHARFINEKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), "y", 1)
		NOKTAYAKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), ".", 1)
		AYYAZ=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),YHARFINEKADAR))
		AYSAYISI=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),NOKTAYAKADAR-1))
		Select Case AYSAYISI
			Case "1" AY="Ocak"
			Case "2" AY="Þubat"
			Case "3" AY="Mart"
			Case "4" AY="Nisan"
			Case "5" AY="Mayýs"
			Case "6" AY="Haziran"
			Case "7" AY="Temmuz"
			Case "8" AY="Aðustos"
			Case "9" AY="Eylül"
			Case "10" AY="Ekim"
			Case "11" AY="Kasým"
			Case "12" AY="Aralýk"
		End Select				
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = AYYAZ & "            " & AY
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	AYKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam           Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO+1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub

Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI 
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK40T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("STOK40T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","STOK40T")
	TABLO.Sort("RTESTARIH")
	TABLO.SafePack()
	MSGBOX TABLO.KOD(1)
	
'	MSGBOX TABLO.GETROWCOUNT()

EXIT SUB
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)

		For i = 1 To SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
			If PUNTAMI <> "PUNTA" Then SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i) = ""
		Next

		SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).SafePack
		MSGBOX SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
		
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "SEVK KODU= " & SEVKKODU_ARR(u) & " - " & "KAYITLAR= " & i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
		
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI 
			If Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			For h=19 To 20 
				If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next
			
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
			For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'HAFTALAR (8 HAFTA)
			For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'AYLAR (4 AY)
			For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+ 1

				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'HAFTA SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, HAFTAKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'AY SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, AYKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,AYKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ()

	Doc.StatusBarMessage i & "Kayýtlar Düzenleniyor, ÝÞLEM DEVAM EDÝYOR !"

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK BAÞLIÐINI BAÞLIK ALTINA KOPYALA-YAZDIRIRKEN HER SAYFADA GÖRÜNMESÝ ÝÇÝN
 	k.Rows("5:5").Select
	k.Selection.Copy
	k.Rows("4:4").Select
	k.Selection.Insert
	k.Rows("6:6").Select
	k.Selection.Delete
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = "KYN1=V347/8 KAYNAK, KYN2=V184 KAYNAK, KYN3=V227 KAYNAK"
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = "MNT1=V347/8 MONTAJ, MNT2=V184 MONTAJ, MNT3=V227 MONTAJ"
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.1)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.25)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 58
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$4"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	CALL PrintLabel()

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintLabel()

	ETKETSEC=""
	KULLANICI=Trim(Doc.Getd7UserName)
	'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	If KULLANICI = "TRM" Then 
		ETIKETSEC=3
	ElseIf KULLANICI	=	"TRM1" Then 
		ETIKETSEC=1
	Else
		ETIKETSEC	=	InputBox ("1- A5 SAYFADA 2 ETÝKET,                                     2- TABLOLU,                                                           3- BARKOD YAZICIYA", "BARKOD ETÝKET SEÇÝMÝ-SAYI GÝRÝN!","2")
		If ETIKETSEC="" Then Exit Sub
	End If	
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	If ETIKETSEC = "" Then Exit Sub
	If Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="2" Then
		SATIRYAZ=2
	ElseIf Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="1" Then
		SATIRYAZ=1
	ElseIf Left(Trim(ETIKETSEC),1)="3" Then
		SATIRYAZ=3
	Else
		SATIRYAZ=1
	End If
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	ETIKET="ETK-OPS2"
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Set DOC1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("D7KIDSLB", "")
	Set D7LB = Doc1.GetTableObject("D7KIDSLB")
	If Doc.GetDocType = "STOK20" Then
		Call STOK20_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK68" Then
		Call STOK68_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK60" Then
		Call STOK60_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK25" Or Doc.GetDocType = "STOKFR2" Or Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK25" Then
		Call STOK25_Print()
	'BÖL VE TRANSFER ET
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK251" Then
		Call STOK251_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29" or Doc.GetDocType = "STOK29I" Then
		Call STOK29_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK36" Then
		Call STOK36_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "D7KIDSPL" Then
		Call D7KIDSPL_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK19" Then
		Call STOK19_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "SAYM11" Then
		Call SAYM11_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK21" Then
		Call STOK21_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK26" Then 
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK26T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "TRACK26" Then 
		'Call STOK25_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK63" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK63T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK61" Then
		Call Transfer_Print(STOK61T)
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "STOK24" Then
		Call STOK24_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType = "MMPS10" Then
		Call MMPS10_Print()
	Elseif Doc.GetDocType= "TRACK01" Then
		Call TRACK01_Print()
	End if

	Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "D7KIDSLB", ""

End Sub

	msgbox "xx"
End Sub
