Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	Dim satirpozr

	Set TKL40T = Doc.GetTableObject("TEKL40T")
	satirSayisi = TKL40T.GetRecCount()
	
	Set TKL40TT = Doc.GetTableObject("YYY")
	if doc.isblank(TKL40TT) then
		TKL40T.CloneTableObject("YYY")
		Set TKL40TT = Doc.GetTableObject("YYY")
		TKL40TT.Addfield2 "STKGK2","CHAR",10,0,"L","",""
	end if

	TKL40TT.Empty()

	For i = 1 to satirSayisi 
		'SATIR EKLEME
		recno=TKL40TT.addrow
		'HÜCREYE TIKLAMA (setcurrentrow ile oluyor)
		TKL40TT.setCURRENTROW(recno)
		TKL40TT.KOD(recno) 				= TKL40T.KOD(i)
		TKL40TT.KOD_STOK00_AD(recno) 	= TKL40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(i)
		TKL40TT.SF_MIKTAR(recno) 	= TKL40T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
		TKL40TT.SF_SF_UNIT(recno) 	= TKL40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
		TKL40TT.OR_FIYAT(recno) 	= TKL40T.OR_FIYAT(i)
		TKL40TT.OR_TUTAR(recno)		= TKL40T.OR_TUTAR(i)
		TKL40TT.PRICEUNIT(recno) = TKL40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
		GRUPKODU2=Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",TKL40TT.KOD(recno),-1))
		If Trim(GRUPKODU2) = "AMPL" Then
			TKL40TT.STKGK2(recno) = GRUPKODU2
		Else
			TKL40TT.STKGK2(recno) = ""
		End If
	Next

	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirbaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirbaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If	
	n = n + 1	
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	SIRANO = 1

	'AMPL
	Set TKL = Doc.Select2G("CCC", "YYY", "STKGK2='AMPL'", "", "STKGK2", -1)
	AMPLTUTAR = TKL.OR_TUTAR

	Set TKL = Doc.Select2("CCC", "YYY", "STKGK2='AMPL'", "", -1)
	AMPLSATIRSAYISI = TKL.GetRecCount()


	If AMPLSATIRSAYISI > 0 Then
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 70, SolMargin, 1, 10, "")
		p = 6
		For t = 1 to AMPLSATIRSAYISI 
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, 1, 10, "")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, p, 10, SIRANO)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, SolMargin + 17, p, 103, Trim(TKL.KOD_STOK00_AD(t)))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 14, TKL.SF_MIKTAR(t))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 5, TKL.SF_SF_UNIT(t))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 17, Doc.NumFormat(TKL.OR_FIYAT(t),12,2))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 21, Doc.NumFormat(TKL.OR_TUTAR(t),12,2))
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 11, Trim(TKL.PRICEUNIT(t)) & " ")
			SIRANO = SIRANO + 1
			res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
			res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, 0, 192)
		Next	
	End If

	'AMPL HARÝCÝ
	Set TKL = Doc.Select2G("CCC", "YYY", "STKGK2=''", "", "STKGK2", -1)
	FARKLITUTAR = TKL.OR_TUTAR

	Set TKL = Doc.Select2("CCC", "YYY", "STKGK2=''", "", -1)
	FARKLISATIRSAYISI = TKL.GetRecCount()
	If FARKLISATIRSAYISI > 0 Then
		res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
		For t = 1 to FARKLISATIRSAYISI 
			res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, 1, 10, "")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, 1, 10, "")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, p, 10, SIRANO)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, SolMargin + 17, p, 103, Trim(TKL.KOD_STOK00_AD(t)))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 14, TKL.SF_MIKTAR(t))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 5, TKL.SF_SF_UNIT(t))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 17, Doc.NumFormat(TKL.OR_FIYAT(t),12,2))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 21, Doc.NumFormat(TKL.OR_TUTAR(t),12,2))
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, p, 11, Trim(TKL.PRICEUNIT(t)) & " ")
			SIRANO = SIRANO + 1
			res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
			res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom, SolMargin, 0, 192)
		Next
	End If

	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 168, SolMargin + 124, 4.5,36, "LAMBA TOPLAMI :")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4.5, 20, Doc.NumFormat(AMPLTUTAR,12,2))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4.5, 11, Trim(TKL.PRICEUNIT(1)) & " ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+1, SolMargin + 124, 4.5, 36, "ARMATÜR TOPLAMI :")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4.5, 20, Doc.NumFormat(FARKLITUTAR,12,2))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 4.5, 11, Trim(TKL.PRICEUNIT(1)) & " ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))

	GENELTOPLAM = AMPLTUTAR + FARKLITUTAR

	res = pe1.SetAlign("Right")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+1, SolMargin + 124, 5, 36, "TOPLAM :")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 20, Doc.NumFormat(GENELTOPLAM,12,2))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 11, Trim(TKL.PRICEUNIT(1)) & " ")
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "TKL40T"
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "TKL"

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub

Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i = 1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin+20 ,SolMargin + 140, 6,30, "Sayfa")
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin+20 ,SolMargin + 160, 6,30,": " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
	Next
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	SAYFAADI = Wb.WorkSheets(1).Name

	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True

	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	Call DEGERLER ()
	'k.Visible = True
	'k.Enable = True

End Sub

'----------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = 2 
	SUTUNNO = 2
	IKISATIRDABIRHARFBOYA_BASLANGIC_SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.SafePack()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
	FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
	FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		' SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		'Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		
		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1)
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO - 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI)
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			DEGERIN_BASLADIGI_KOLON = SUTUNNO

			'GÜNLER
			For v = KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
 					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For j = IKISATIRDABIRHARFBOYA_BASLANGIC_SATIRNO To SATIRNO+SAYACY Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	Next
	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub

Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")

	BUGUNKONTROL_TARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)

	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 1
	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Grup"
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(16,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(17,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

'----------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=18
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
			'SIPARIS BASLIKLARINDAKI TARIH

		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)

' ÐÐÐ
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
			'SIPARIS EVRAK TARIHI
		EVRAKTARIHI_KONTROLICIN=Doc.StrtoNorDate(BUGUNKONTROL_TARIHI)
		EVRAKTARIHI_KONTROLICIN=Left(EVRAKTARIHI_KONTROLICIN,6)

		If EVRAKTARIHI_KONTROLICIN = TARIH Then
			BUGUNUNKOLONYERI = SUTUNNO
		End If

		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	If BUGUNUNKOLONYERI = "" Then
		Msgbox "Evrak tarihi ile eþleþen termin tarihi bulunamadý. Kontrol ediniz!"
		Exit Sub
	End If
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub

Sub MAKYAJ()

	'********************************************************************************************************
	'GRUPLA
	'*********************************************************************************************************
'	Sheet.Rows("4:5").Select
'	k.selection.Delete
	Const xlAscending = 1
	Const xlYes = 1

	Set objWorksheet = Wb.Sheets(SAYFAADI)
	Set objRange = objWorksheet.UsedRange 
	Set objRange2 = k.Range("A1") 
	objRange.Sort objRange2, xlAscending, , , , , , xlYes 

	Set GRUPKODU2TABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sssd6t", "STOK00", "", "", -1)
	GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GROUPBY("GK_2")
	GRUPKODU2_KAYITSAYISI = GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GETRECCOUNT

	SATIRKONUM = 0
	SAYACY = 0

	For i = 1 to GRUPKODU2_KAYITSAYISI
		If i = 1 Then 
			SATIRKONUM = 2
		Else 
			SATIRKONUM = SATIRKONUM + 1
		End If
		GRUPKODU = Trim(GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GK_2(i))
     If GRUPKODU <> "" Then 
			QSTR = """" + GRUPKODU + """"
			'C ve R nin anlamý formülün bulunduðu hücreden C kadar +deðer ise saða - deðer ise sola ötele.
			Sheet.Range("CA"&i).FORMULA = "=COUNTIF(R[1]C[-78]:R[1000]C[-78], " + QSTR + ")" 
			GRUP2_KODLU_PARCA_SAYISI(i) = Sheet.Range("CA"&i).Value 
			If GRUP2_KODLU_PARCA_SAYISI(i) <> 0 Then
				SATIRKONUM = SATIRKONUM + GRUP2_KODLU_PARCA_SAYISI(i)
				Sheet.Rows(SATIRKONUM).Select
				k.selection.Insert
				k.Selection.RowHeight =  5
				Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRKONUM, 1),Sheet.Cells(SATIRKONUM,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
				k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 1
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
				SAYACY= SAYACY + 1
			Else
				SATIRKONUM = SATIRKONUM - 1
			End If
		End If
	Next

	SATIRKONUM = 0
	'******************************************************************************************************
	
	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR+SAYACY-1
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'TOPLAM DEÐERÝ
	For p = 2 to TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI 
		'TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI
		Sheet.Cells(p, DEGERIN_BASLADIGI_KOLON).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		'TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI 
		Sheet.Cells(p, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		QSTR = TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI & ":" & TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI
		Sheet.Cells(p, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI).Formula = "=SUM(" + QSTR + ")" 
	Next
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
'	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
'	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
'	k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
'	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
'	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
'	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
'	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		'k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 4 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		If Left(Sheet.Cells(1, i).Value,3) = "Pzt" Then
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, i-1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i-1)).Select
			k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
			k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
		End If
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'TOPLAM KOLONU DÝK ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 3.60
	Sheet.Columns(1).Select		
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SÝPARÝÞ EVRAK TARÝHÝ KOLONU BOYAMA
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI), Sheet.cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI)).Select
	k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 15
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SÝPARÝÞ EVRAK TARÝHÝNÝN SOL TARAFINDAKÝ TOPLAM MÝKTAR
	Sheet.Columns(BUGUNUNKOLONYERI).Select
	k.selection.Insert
	Sheet.Cells(1, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI).Value = "Eski Topl."
		'ESKÝ TOPLAM DEÐERÝ
	For r = 2 to TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI -1
			'TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI
		Sheet.Cells(r, DEGERIN_BASLADIGI_KOLON).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

			'TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI 
		Sheet.Cells(r, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI-1).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		QSTR = TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI & ":" & TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI
		Sheet.Cells(r, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI).Formula = "=SUM(" + QSTR + ")" 
	Next
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'TOPLAM DEÐERÝ
	For p = 2 to TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI 
		'TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI
		Sheet.Cells(p, DEGERIN_BASLADIGI_KOLON).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		'TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI 
		Sheet.Cells(p, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		'TOPLAMICIN_TOPLAMDAN ÇIKACAK DEGER 
		Sheet.Cells(p, BUGUNUNKOLONYERI).Select
		TOPLAMICIN_TOPLAMDAN_CIKACAK_DEGER_HUCRESI = k.selection.Address

		QSTR = TOPLAMICIN_BASLANGIC_HUCRESI & ":" & TOPLAMICIN_BITIS_HUCRESI
		'QSTR = QSTR - TOPLAMICIN_TOPLAMDAN_CIKACAK_DEGER
		Sheet.Cells(p, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI+1).Formula = "=SUM(" + QSTR + ")" + "-" +  TOPLAMICIN_TOPLAMDAN_CIKACAK_DEGER_HUCRESI

		'EN ALTA GRUP ADLARINI YAZDIRMA
	Set GRUPKODU2TABLOSU = Doc.Select1("sssd6t", "STOK00", "", "", -1)
	GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GROUPBY("GK_2")
	GRUPKODU2_KAYITSAYISI = GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GETRECCOUNT
	GRUPKODAD1 = 0	
	GRUPKODAD2 = 0
 
	For i = GRUPKODU2_KAYITSAYISI to 1 step -1
		GRUPKODU = Trim(GRUPKODU2TABLOSU.GK_2(i))

 			GRUPADI = Trim(doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK2","AD",GRUPKODU,-1))

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI+1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI+1)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 56
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$1"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, sayfaSatirSayisi, ST60,SiparisFaturaNiteligi,sat_rty

Public Grid()
Sub PrintForm()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK60T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set ST60 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	ST60.CopyTable(S60T)
	ST60.GroupBy2("KOD")

	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

	siraNo = 0
	sat_rty = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 203
	sayfaEni = 271
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	ustmargin = 0
	satirBaslangic = ustmargin + 18 * satirYuksekligi
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 30
	solmargin = 0
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	Call Alanlar()
'	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
'		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
'		Exit Sub
'	End If

	satirSayisi = ST60.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	if Doc.GetDocType0 = "TRACK601" Then
		res = pe1.PrintDoc(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.Show()
	End if
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)

	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	if trim(STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1) = "" then
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	else
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	end if


	vergidairesi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGIDAIRESI(1)
	vergino = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGINO(1)
	tarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	if trim(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH) = "" then
		sevktarih = Tarih
	else
		sevktarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH)
	end if

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 9* satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 165, 5,30, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 10.5* satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 40, sevktarih)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 7 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 22, 5, 80, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 8* satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 22, 5, 80, adres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 80, adres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 10 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 80, adres3)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 14 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 50, 5, 60, vergidairesi & " " & vergino)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		
		Dim satirpozr
		If trim(ST60.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic * sat_rty
			sat_rty = 0
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1

		
		if sat_rty = "0" Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic + ((siraNo - 1) + sat_rty) * satiryuksekligi
		else
			satirpozr = sonSatir + satiryuksekligi
		end if		

		res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin + 1

		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			stokkodu = ST60.KOD(satirno)						
			aciklama = ST60.NOTES(satirno)
			MStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
			MStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
			SipNo = ST60.SIPNO(satirno)
			ArtNo = ST60.SIPARTNO(satirno)
			MSipNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", sipno, "")
			SiparisFaturaNiteligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK",STOK60T.SIPNO(satirno),"") 

			Select Case trim(degiskenAdi)
				case "_SIRA***"
					degisken = siraNo
				case "_AD"
					if trim(MStokKodu) = "" Then
						degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						degisken = MStokKodu
					end if
				case else
				Degisken = ST60.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			end select
			
			res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			if trim(stokkodu) = "3-02-02-0554" then
				if degiskenadi="SF_MIKTAR" then
					degisken=ST60.SF_MIKTAR(satirno) * Doc.Stok00_toUnit(stokkodu,ST60.SF_SF_UNIT(satirno),"TAKIM",-1)
				elseif degiskenadi="SF_SF_UNIT" then
					degisken="TAKIM"
				end if
			end if
			
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			
			if degiskenadi = "_AD" Then

				if trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")) <> "" THEN
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")))
					sat_rty = 1
				
					if trim(aciklama) <> "" then
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr + 2 * satiryuksekligi, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, trim(aciklama))
						sat_rty = sat_rty + 1
					end if
				else
					sat_rty = 0
				end if		
				
			end if
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	not1 = STOK60E.NOTES_1(1)
	not2 = STOK60E.NOTES_2(1)
	not3 = STOK60E.NOTES_3(1)
	Sofor = STOK60E.BOX1_2
	PlakaNo = STOK60E.BOX1_3

	if trim(SiparisFaturaNiteligi) = "NC" then
		res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 35 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 40, 5, 50, "FATURA EDÝLMEYECEKTÝR!....")
	Elseif trim(SiparisFaturaNiteligi) = "Z4" then
		res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 35 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 40, 5, 50, "REWORK ÝÞLEM UYGULANMIÞTIR!...")
	End if

	res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 38 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 40, 5, 50, Sofor)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.getLeft, 5, 30, PlakaNo)

	'res = pe1.write(UstMargin + 38 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 150, 5, 30, Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH))
	'res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.getLeft, 5, 30, Doc.Saat(5))


'	res = pe1.write(215, solmargin, 5, 250, not1)
'	res = pe1.write(220, solmargin, 5, 250, not2)
'	res = pe1.write(225, solmargin, 5, 250, not3)

'	res = pe1.write(240, solmargin + 125, 5, 65, Sofor)
'	res = pe1.write(244, solmargin + 125, 5, 65, PlakaNo)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_SIRA"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SIPNO"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 9
	Grid(1,1) = 30
	Grid(2,1) = 62
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 26
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = ST60.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, sayfaSatirSayisi, ST60,SiparisFaturaNiteligi,sat_rty

Sub PrintForm()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK60T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set ST60 = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	ST60.CopyTable(S60T)
	ST60.GroupBy2("KOD")

	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

	siraNo = 0
	sat_rty = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 203
	sayfaEni = 271
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Irsaliye", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	ustmargin = 0
	satirBaslangic = ustmargin + 18 * satirYuksekligi
	sayfaSatirSayisi = 30
	solmargin = 0
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 10

	Call Alanlar()
'	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
'		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
'		Exit Sub
'	End If

	satirSayisi = ST60.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	if Doc.GetDocType0 = "TRACK601" Then
		res = pe1.PrintDoc(1)
	Else
		res = pe1.Show()
	End if
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)

	chkodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_AD(1)
	if trim(STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1) = "" then
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_ADRES_3(1)
	else
		adres1 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		adres2 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
		adres3 = 	STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	end if


	vergidairesi = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGIDAIRESI(1)
	vergino = STOK60E.CH_KODU_CARI00_VERGINO(1)
	tarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	if trim(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH) = "" then
		sevktarih = Tarih
	else
		sevktarih = Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH)
	end if

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 9* satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 165, 5,30, tarih)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 10.5* satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 40, sevktarih)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 7 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 22, 5, 80, chadi)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 8* satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 22, 5, 80, adres1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 80, adres2)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 10 * satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 80, adres3)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 14 * satirYuksekligi, solmargin + 50, 5, 60, vergidairesi & " " & vergino)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		
		Dim satirpozr
		If trim(ST60.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If siraNo > sayfaSatirSayisi Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic * sat_rty
			sat_rty = 0
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1

		
		if sat_rty = "0" Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic + ((siraNo - 1) + sat_rty) * satiryuksekligi
		else
			satirpozr = sonSatir + satiryuksekligi
		end if		

		res = pe1.selectfont("Courier New", 7)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin + 1

		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			stokkodu = ST60.KOD(satirno)						
			aciklama = ST60.NOTES(satirno)
			MStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(stokkodu,chkodu)
			MStokAdi = Doc.GetCHStokAdi(stokkodu,chkodu)
			SipNo = ST60.SIPNO(satirno)
			ArtNo = ST60.SIPARTNO(satirno)
			MSipNo = doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", sipno, "")
			SiparisFaturaNiteligi = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK40E","MUHT_FATURA_NITELIK",STOK60T.SIPNO(satirno),"") 

			Select Case trim(degiskenAdi)
				case "_SIRA***"
					degisken = siraNo
				case "_AD"
					if trim(MStokKodu) = "" Then
						degisken = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "AD", StokKodu, "")
					Else
						degisken = MStokKodu
					end if
				case else
				Degisken = ST60.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			end select
			
			res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			if trim(stokkodu) = "3-02-02-0554" then
				if degiskenadi="SF_MIKTAR" then
					degisken=ST60.SF_MIKTAR(satirno) * Doc.Stok00_toUnit(stokkodu,ST60.SF_SF_UNIT(satirno),"TAKIM",-1)
				elseif degiskenadi="SF_SF_UNIT" then
					degisken="TAKIM"
				end if
			end if
			
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			
			if degiskenadi = "_AD" Then

				if trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")) <> "" THEN
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "NAME2", StokKodu, "")))
					sat_rty = 1
				
					if trim(aciklama) <> "" then
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr + 2 * satiryuksekligi, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, trim(aciklama))
						sat_rty = sat_rty + 1
					end if
				else
					sat_rty = 0
				end if		
				
			end if
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub

Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : BOMU01

Kod : 
Public k(20),TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,satir,sheet,ExcelApp,wb1,mamulkodu

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	
	'*******************************************************************************************
	Wb1.ActiveSheet.Cells.Select
	With ExcelApp.Selection.Font
		.Name = "Agency FB"
		.Size = 8
	End With

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
	'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF"))
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							URUNAGACIFOYNO = ""
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							URUNAGACIFOYNO = Trim(Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF"))
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P3.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
								Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "	STOK00", ""
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P3.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Else
							'msgbox "kodu ve resimi kontrol et"
							Resim1 = ""
							URUNAGACIFOYNO = ""
						End If
					End If
	'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					On Error Resume Next
					If Resim1 <> "" Then
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
						rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
						rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, 1).Select
						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
						resimadi=resim.name
						wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
						resim.Left = rleft 
						resim.Top = rtop
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 10
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 25
					End If
'******************************************************************************
					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, BASLANGIC_KOLONU+seviye).Value = Degerorj2 & " (" & URUNAGACIFOYNO & ")"
				End if
			End if
		Next

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 2.KOLON (OP.NO)
		For j = 1 to 1
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,2).Value = Degerorj  
			End if
		Next

		AGAC_SONU_KOLONU = 	maxseviye + 3
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 7.KOLON
		For j = 7 to 7
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = "'" & Degerorj 
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next
		
		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		satir = satir + 1
	Next

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,1).Select

	ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
	
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,1).Value = "Resim"
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,2).Value = "OP. NO"
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,3).Value = "ÖPS Kodlamasý"
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(7,2),"\n", " ")
	ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(8,2),"\n", " ")

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ
	Sheet.Cells.Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 12
	ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlTop

	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(1).RowHeight = 20
	'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, i).Select
		'ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 8
		ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True 
		ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
		ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
	If Resim2 <> "" THEN
		rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Top+1.5
		rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Left+1.5
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI).Select
		Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim2)) 
		resimadi=resim.name
		wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
		resim.Left = rleft 
		resim.Top = rtop
		ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
		ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 15
		ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
	End If
	Resim2 = ""

	'RESÝM KOLONU AYARI
	Wb1.Sheets(1).Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 5
	Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(1).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment= 3 'xlCenter

	For g = 3 to AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1  
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(g).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment= 1
		if g = 3 Then
			ExcelApp.Selection.ColumnWidth = 2
		elseif g = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU Then
			ExcelApp.Selection.ColumnWidth = 7.5
		Else
			ExcelApp.Selection.ColumnWidth = 3
		End If
	Next

	For h = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU+1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(h).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment= 1
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(h).autofit
	Next

	For h = 2 to 2
		Wb1.Sheets(1).Columns(h).ColumnWidth = 3
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(h).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment= 3 'xlCenter
	Next

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri-1, 1), Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).value = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri+1,3).value & " - " & Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri+1,AGAC_SONU_KOLONU+1).value
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 10
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 3), Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, AGAC_SONU_KOLONU)).Merge
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select
	Wb1.ActiveSheet.Rows(2).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment= 3 'xlCenter
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells.Select

	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 1  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 1  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 1			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 1  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(48,17)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		'.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.39)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.19)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.19)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = 100
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
		'.PaperSize = 1
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     '.ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     '.AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = False
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		'.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic,Tip
Public AlanSayisi()		 
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

	'sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")
	sayfaTuru = "A"
	Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
		Case "L"
			sayfaBoyu = 279.4
			sayfaEni = 215.9
		Case "A"
			sayfaBoyu = 297
			sayfaEni = 210
		Case Else
			K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
	End Select					
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

	Call Alanlar()
	If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
		k = SayfaBoyu
		l = SayfaEni
		SayfaEni = k
		SayfaBoyu = l
		Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Grup Kodu Tanýmlarý", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	Else
		Tip = ""
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Grup Kodu Tanýmlarý", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
	End If		

	BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
	satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

	satirBaslangic = 70

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	Dim pe1
	siraNo = 0        
	Dim satirSayisi_tableT
	satirSayisi_tableT = GECOUST.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(0)
	res = pe1.box(8, 8, 30, SayfaEni-110)
	res = pe1.UseSet(1001)
	res = pe1.RemoveSet(1001)
        
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If Tip = "LANDSCAPE" Then
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(15, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Grup Kodu Tanýmlarý")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(12, 10, 15, 55, logo, 82)
		End If
	Else
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.setbold(1)
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaEni - 30, "Grup Kodu Tanýmlarý")
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		If logo <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(11, 10, 10, 35, logo, 82)
		End If
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Helvetica", "12")
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", "10")

	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = 32
	SatirAra = 8
		
	KodTipi = GECOUSE.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 12, 6, 28, "Kod Tipi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & trim(KodTipi))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 12, 6, 28, "Açýklama")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & GECOUSE.ACIKLAMA(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 12, 6, 28, "Kod Uzunluðu")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		
'***********************		
	Oran = BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn

	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	Sol = 12
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) / 3.22 * Oran
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then	
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 13, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		End If
	Next

	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(28, 10, 0, SayfaEni-20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 2, 10, 0, sayfaEni -20)
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(0, 0, 0))        
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Dim satiryuksekligi, x
	satiryuksekligi = 6

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If
		
	res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
	FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", FontBoyu)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = 12
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

		Degisken = trim(cstr(GECOUST.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))

		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		
		If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
			If Grid(i,0) = "AD_L2" Then  Degisken = ""

			If Grid(i,0) = "KOD" Then 
				res = pe1.NoPen()
				res = pe1.Barcode(satirpozr, Sol+120, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, "CODE128", "%FR%" & Trim(Degisken), "")
			End If
			
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
			j = j + 1

		End If	

	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, 10, satirSonu - 3, SayfaEni - 20)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
	  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If LineX = 0 Then Exit For
	  res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 14, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 19, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","GECOUST")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		k = Grid(i,2)
		m =instr(1,k,chr(10)) 
		If m > 0 Then
			Grid(i,2)= Replace(Grid(i,2),chr(10)," ")
	 	End If
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = GECOUST.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 10,120,logo,114)
		Else
			res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 6,120,FirmaAdi)
		End If
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		MPSRefNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)

		MamulKodu = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
		MamulAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",MamulKodu,-1)
		UretimSipNo = MMPS10E.MUSTERISIPINO(1)
		GrupNo = MMPS10E.GRUPEVRAKNO(1)
		ToleransTipi = MMPS10E.TOLERANSTYPE(1)
		Tolerans = MMPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MMPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,-1)
		printt=doc.GetUDFValue("MMPS10E",MMPS10E.EVRAKNO,"TARIH",0)
		MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
		MusteriAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+17
		SatirAra = 6
		
		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"MPS Ref No")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,trim(MPSRefNo))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,85,MamulKodu)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6, sagMargin - SolMargin - 38,MamulAdi)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")

									Tolerans & ")")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Teslim Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,TeslimTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Müþteri")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MusteriAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Notlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 7 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not2)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 7 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not2)

		res = pe1.SetBold(2)
		res = pe1.Print(pe1.GetTop + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2,"Mühendislik Deðiþiklik Seviyesi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Print(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1,": " & Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "SUPPLIERCODE", MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU,""))
		Alt = pe1.GetBottom()


		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"Kalýp Baðlama")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, pe1.GetRight, 6,40,": ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"Ayar Süresi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, pe1.GetRight, 6,40,": ")

		res = pe1.Line(Alt + 2, SolMargin,0,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(Alt + 4, SolMargin,6,SagMargin - SolMargin,"STANDART ÝÞ TANIMI")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		SatirAra = 4
		Set Tbl1 = GetSTCNTable()
		satirSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Tbl1.GetRowCount / 2)
		Basla = Alt + 4 + 2 * SatirAra
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		For i = 1 to Tbl1.GetRowCount()
			satirPos = Basla + ((i - 1) mod satirSayisi) * satirAra
			if i <= satirSayisi Then
				sol = solMargin + 2
			Else
				sol = solMargin + 90
			End if
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, sol,6,55,Tbl1.NOTES(i))
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetLeft + 56,6,2,":")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetLeft + 3,6,15,Tbl1.SF_MIKTAR(i))
			if pe1.GetBottom > EnAlt Then EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom
		Next

		res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - BBasla + 2,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		if Tbl1.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
			res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
			res = pe1.Line(Basla, SolMargin + 88,pe1.GetBottom - Basla,0)
		End if

		Basla1 = EnAlt + 2
		Dim Grid(6,1)
		Grid(0,0) = "Gün"
		Grid(1,0) = "Baþlama Saati"
		Grid(2,0) = "Bitiþ Saati"
		Grid(3,0) = "Üretilmesi Gereken"
		Grid(4,0) = "Hedef Üretim"
		Grid(5,0) = "Gerçekleþen Üretim"
		Grid(6,0) = "Açýklama"

		Grid(0,1) = 20
		Grid(1,1) = 20
		Grid(2,1) = 20
		Grid(3,1) = 20
		Grid(4,1) = 20
		Grid(5,1) = 25
		Grid(6,1) = 55

		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		sol = solMargin + 1
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		For i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
			res = pe1.Write(Basla1, sol, 10, Grid(i,1) - 2, Grid(i,0))
			sol = sol + Grid(i,1)
		Next
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
,
		GunlukUretimMiktari = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_MINIMUMSIPMIKTARI", MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU, "")
		if GunlukUretimMiktari = 0 Then GunlukUretimMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR
		Kalan = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR

		sBasla = pe1.GetBottom()
		Aralik1 = 5
		j = 0
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
		Gun = MMPS10E.REVURETIMDENTESTARIH
		Do
			j = j + 1
			satirPos = sBasla + (j - 1) * Aralik1
			sol = solMargin + 1
			d7Date.SetDate Gun
			d7Date.Increment -1
			if d7Date.GetDOW = 7 Then d7Date.Increment -1
			Gun = d7Date.GetRevDate()
			if Kalan < GunlukUretimMiktari Then
				UretilmesiGereken = Kalan
			Else
				UretilmesiGereken = GunlukUretimMiktari
			End if
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, solMargin + 1, 5, Grid(0,1) - 2, Doc.StrToNorDate(Gun))
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(1,1) - 2, "20:00")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(2,1) - 2, "08:00")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(3,1) - 2, UretilmesiGereken)
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(4,1) - 2, GunlukUretimMiktari)

			Kalan = Kalan - GunlukUretimMiktari
		Loop While Kalan > 0
		satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 2

		res = pe1.Box(Basla1 - 1, solMargin, pe1.GetBottom - Basla1 + 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
		cizgiBoyu = pe1.GetBottom - pe1.GetTop
		KutuUst = pe1.GetTop
		res = pe1.Line(sBasla - 1, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
		sol = solMargin
		For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1) - 1
			sol = sol + Grid(i,1)
			res = pe1.Line(KutuUst, sol, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
'sss
	If trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)

	Ekler = SatirSatir(SatirNo) + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + Ekler
	
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
'		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = UstMargin + 6
	Else
		If SiraNo = 0 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
'				satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		

	satirBas = satirPozr

	TezgahKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	TezgahAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",TezgahKodu,-1)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	OperasyonAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
	YMMiktari = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(YMMiktari)
	YMMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(YMMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	OperasyonSuresi = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(SatirNo)
	OP_IS_NO = Trim(MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo))

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.Box(SatirPozr, SolMargin,7,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr + 1, SolMargin,5,SagMargin - SolMargin,trim(TezgahAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi + 2

	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Ýþ Merkezi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,100,": " & trim(TezgahKodu) & " - " & trim(TezgahAdi))
	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,65,": " & OperasyonAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 105,5,23,"Ayar Süresi")
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 129,5,3,":")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 132,5,15,AyarSuresi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 149,5,12,"SAAT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 161,5,30,"..............")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 105,5,23,"Oper. Süresi")
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 129,5,3,":")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 132,5,15,OperasyonSuresi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 149,5,12,"SAAT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 161,5,30,"..............")

		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Üretim Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,65,": " & YMMiktari)
	'*************************************************************************************************************
	'bymozan
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	BARKODGEN= 80
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(1)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeParms(0,0)
	'res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoChecksum(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Barcode(SatirPozr+3, 105, 10, BARKODGEN, "CODE128", "%JB%" & OP_IS_NO, "")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
	End If
	
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
	SatirSon = pe1.GetBottom()

	SatirPozr = SatirPozr + 10

	Call MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call MesajYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
	SatirSon = SatirSon + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + 2

	HammaddeSon = SatirSon + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + 2
	
'xxx
	res = pe1.Box(SatirBas ,SolMargin,SatirSon - SatirBas,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	If HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) > 0 Then
		res = pe1.Box(SatirSon,SolMargin,HammaddeSon - SatirSon,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	End If
' amman dikkat bu satýr önemli! ***********
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom() - 2,2,3,5,"")
'******************************************

End Sub
Function SatirSatir(satirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)

	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		k = 4
	Else 
		k = 2
	End If
	satirSatir = k * SatirYuksekligi
End Function
Sub MesajYaz(pe1,SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG2","KRITER+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG2_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			Dosya = Old.Notes(i)
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr() + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.Picture(SatirPozr, Solmargin + 30, 50,120,"..\wd\images\" & trim(Dosya),114)
			res = pe1.UseSet(1)
		Else
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i) 
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,120,Mesaj)
		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function MesajSatir(SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG2","KRITER+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG2_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			k = k + 55
		Else
			k = k + SatirYuksekligi
		End If
	Next
	MesajSatir = k
End Function
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 32,Tanim)
	Next
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Function Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)

	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")

	MuhendislikSatir = Tech.GetRecCount() * SatirYuksekligi

End Function
Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
		'	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,Doc.Stok00c_SonMik(HammaddeKodu,"YMM"))

			res = pe1.setbold(0)
			res=pe1.selectfont("arial",8)
			res = pe1.write(ustMargin+270,10,-2,50,"03 FRM 004")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'SAS
	Alt = pe1.GetBottom()
	
End Sub
Sub Hazirlayan(pe1,SatirPozr)
	If (satirPozr + 30) > satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satirPozr = UstMargin + 6
	End If
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,SolMargin,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "HAZIRLAYAN")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "ONAYLAYAN")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 3,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,30,0)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 12,SolMargin,0,SagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Box(satirPozr + 3,SolMargin,30,SagMargin-SolMargin)
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i = 1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		If i = 1 Then
			res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 10, SagMargin - 30, 6,30, "\b Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
		Else
			res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin , SagMargin - 30, 6,30, "\b Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
		End If
	Next
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function ParlaticiYaz(pKod)
	For i = 1 To Len(cStr(pKod))
		If i = 1 Then
			Parlatici = pAdi(mid(cStr(pKod),i,1))
		Else
			Parlatici = Parlatici & ", " & pAdi(mid(cStr(pKod),i,1)	)
		End If
	Next
    ParlaticiYaz = Parlatici
End Function
Function pAdi(pKod)
	Select Case pKod
		Case 2
			pAdi = "DÝSP"
		Case 3
			pAdi = "SOLV"
		Case 4
			pAdi = "UV"
		Case 6
			pAdi = "BLIST"
		Case 7
			pAdi = "PRIMER"
		Case 8
			pAdi = "S.TATB"
		Case 9
			pAdi = "VÝKOLÝT"
	End Select
End Function
Function GetSTCNTable()
	TablStr = "xxwewfwfsf"
	Doc.CreateTableObject TablStr & "=STOK40T", "TMPCOPY"  
	Set GetSTCNTable = Doc.GetTableObject(TablStr)
	Set S00 = Doc.Select1("wefwefrwe", "STOK00", "KOD='" & MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to 25
		BBTech = S00.GetFieldValue("B_B_TECH_" & i, 1)
		If Doc.DRound(BBTech) > 0 Then
			satirNo = GetSTCNTable.AddRow
			StokTekN = Doc.Customp_Gets("STCN" & Right("00" & i,2))
			StokTekN = replace(StokTekN,":","")
			GetSTCNTable.NOTES(satirNo) = StokTekN
			GetSTCNTable.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) = Doc.DRound(BBTech)
		End If
	Next
End Function

Public SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin, SagMargin, UstMargin, AltMargin, DikeyBilgiAlani, YatayBilgiAlani,satirpozr, Baslik01sagcizgialtkonum

Sub PrintForm()

	'Sayfa Ayarlarý
	ReDim ToplamGrid(1)
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = 10
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = 10
	SatirYuksekligi = 5
 	
	Tip1 = "LANDSCAPE"
	Tip2 = "PORTRAIT"

	Tip = Tip2
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
	If Tip = Tip1 Then      '//  yatay sayfa
		SayfaBoyu = 210
		SayfaEni = 297
		DikeyBilgiAlani = SayfaBoyu - (UstMargin + AltMargin)
		YatayBilgiAlani = SayfaEni - (SolMargin + SagMargin)	
		SayfaSonuBaslangicSatiri = (DikeyBilgiAlani+UstMargin) - (10*SatirYuksekligi)
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
	ElseIf Tip = Tip2 Then     '// dikey sayfa
		SayfaBoyu = 297
		SayfaEni = 210
		DikeyBilgiAlani = SayfaBoyu - (UstMargin + AltMargin)
		YatayBilgiAlani = SayfaEni - (SolMargin + SagMargin)	
		SayfaSonuBaslangicSatiri = (DikeyBilgiAlani+UstMargin) - (10*SatirYuksekligi)
		res = pe1.Open(0, VPEAdi, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, Tip)
	End If
	
	Call Print_Form_SayfaBasi()
	Call Alanlar()
		
	KayitSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	For j = 1 To KayitSayisi
		Call Print_Form_Satir(j)
	Next	
	Call Print_Form_SayfaSonu()
	Call SayfaSayisi()
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)	
	
End Sub
